title: Stage assistant chef de projet évènementiel (H/F/X) - Lyon
description: Le stage se déroulera au sein du service Sensibilisation-Communication de Handicap International, au siège de Lyon, du 1er avril au 30 septembre 2027. Il contribuera à la préparation et à l’animation des Pyramides de chaussures 2027, ainsi qu’à l’organisation d’autres événements de l’association.Les Pyramides de chaussures c’est le temps fort de sensibilisation et de mobilisation citoyenne pour Handicap International. Depuis plus de 30 ans, tous les citoyens, scolaires, salariés d’entreprises, sympathisants de Handicap International ou encore politiques sont invités à venir : - Lancer leurs chaussures pour témoigner de leur soutien aux causes portées par Handicap International, la chaussure symbole du poids de l’engagement citoyen pour protéger les civils ; - S’informer à travers une exposition interactive, ludique et pédagogique sur Handicap International, ses champs d’intervention et ses combats ; - Rencontrer et échanger avec nos experts terrain. Pour en savoir plus sur les Pyramides : https://www.handicap-international.fr/fr/pyramides-de-chaussures Le stage associe coordination événementielle, relations avec les partenaires et prestataires, recrutement et animation de la communauté de bénévoles, préparation de supports et de matériel, animation et participation aux événements. En complément, nous vous invitons à prendre connaissance des actions de sensibilisation et mobilisation en consultant : l’Espace du bénévolat et de la sensibilisation pour Handicap International . La mission se déroulera du 1e avril au 30 septembre 2027 (6 mois). Vos missions sont les suivantes Activité 1 : Vous appuyez l’organisation et la coordination des Pyramides de chaussures de Villeurbanne et Paris avec · La participation à la conception et à la logistique opérationnelle des Pyramides (scénographies, matériel, présence sur événement, montage/démontage). · L’appui au recrutement, à l’animation et au suivi des bénévoles, ainsi qu’à leur formation et fidélisation. · La coordination de la Journée des Scolaires et l’organisation des visites guidées pour tous les publics. · La recherche de prestataires. · La contribution aux bilans : recueillir les retours des équipes et partenaires, documenter les résultats et proposer des améliorations pour les prochaines éditions. Activité 2 : Vous participez à l’organisation d’autres événements de Handicap International · Congrès des Notaires : contribuer à la définition et à l’adaptation des messages clés, à la conception du stand et du parcours de sensibilisation, à la préparation des supports, du matériel et d’un kit d’animation, ainsi qu’à l’organisation. · Vœux 2028 : participer à la recherche et à la sélection d’un lieu insolite adapté à l’événement, imaginer des propositions d’animation et contribuer à l’identification, à la consultation et au suivi des prestataires. · Plus largement, apporter un appui à la coordination, à la logistique et au suivi des événements transversaux de l’Association Nationale France. Activité 3 – Participer à la vie quotidienne du service Sensibilisation-Communication · Contribuer à la gestion de boîtes mail et au suivi des sollicitations, au suivi d’actions solidaires et à la préparation de nouvelles actions ou événements de mobilisation. · Contribuer à l'animation et au déploiement du défi de Damien Seguin pour l'inclusion et la solidarité internationale, avec un focus sur le volet scolaire : mobilisation et accompagnement des établissements scolaires, diffusion des outils pédagogiques, appui à l'organisation d'actions de sensibilisation et de défis solidaires, suivi des établissements participants et valorisation de leurs initiatives. ACCESSIBILITE DU LIEU DE TRAVAIL : Le poste est situé en Open Space, des box sont mis à disposition pour plus de calme si nécessaire et l’espace de travail est très lumineux. Le poste est facilement accessible en transports en commun (bus, métro). Un parking est également à disposition. Concernant le bâtiment, des ascenseurs et des rampes d'accès sont mis en place. Requirements Profil recherché: - Vous êtes en formation en gestion de projet évènementiel - Vous avez une première expérience dans la gestion de projet évènementielle - vous avez une aisance relationnelle avérée (public adulte et enfants) - Vous avez un excellent niveau en français à l’écrit ainsi qu’à l’oral - Une expérience dans le bénévolat serait la bienvenue Benefits CONDITIONS Duree: 6 mois Type de contrat: Stage Salaire: - Gratification mensuelle de 693€ - Tickets restaurant d’une valeur faciale de 8,96 euros (60 % à la charge de l’employeur, 40% à votre charge) - Participation de 50% à votre abonnement au titre des transports - Des déplacements sont à prévoir - De nombreuses activités sportives et sociales sont proposées dans nos locaux Vous devez disposer d’une convention de stage obligatoire délivrée par un établissement d’enseignement ou de formation français. Les stages proposés chez HI donnent l’occasion aux étudiants d’évoluer dans une organisation internationale et de prendre part à l’action d’Humanité & Inclusion. Nous considérons que les stagiaires pour qui l’expérience s’est bien passée sont nos talents de demain ! Merci d’envoyer votre CV et Lettre de motivation à : ----- Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation - Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)
description: Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation – Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F) À propos de notre client Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux. Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE. Le poste Votre rôle : mettre au point de véritables méthodes d’essai. À partir d’un besoin de mesure (température, pression, déplacement, déformation, ultrasons…), vous concevez, instrumentez et validez des cellules d’essais haute température et haute pression. Vous commencez par fiabiliser une cellule existante : simplifier son montage et son démontage, puis la valider à plus haute température. Vous lancez ensuite les cellules suivantes. Vous travaillez avec l’équipe qui conçoit aujourd’hui les équipements, et avec le bureau d’études d’un fabricant partenaire qui réalise la conception détaillée et les plans de fabrication. Environ 70-80 % conception et développement, 20-30 % laboratoire. Rattachement à la direction des opérations. Ce que le poste n’est pas : ni dessinateur ou calculateur (le détail et les plans sont externalisés), ni management d’équipe. Vos missions Définir le besoin, le cahier des charges et le pré-dimensionnement fonctionnel de nouvelles cellules. Choisir les capteurs adaptés et les intégrer ; résoudre les enjeux d’étanchéité, de tenue en température et en pression. Consulter fournisseurs et sous-traitants, suivre la fabrication des pièces. Monter, instrumenter et tester vous-même vos équipements au laboratoire ; interpréter les mesures et améliorer. Améliorer l’ergonomie des équipements existants et transférer les équipements validés à l’équipe d’essais. Rédiger la documentation technique et contribuer à la protection de la propriété intellectuelle. Requirements Indispensable Conception mécanique d’équipements, avec une CAO 3D (aucun logiciel imposé). Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure physique et physico-chimique : choisir et intégrer, pas fabriquer. Goût du terrain : vous aimez monter, démonter et intervenir vous-même sur les équipements. Important Gestion de projet : planning, budget, fournisseurs. Rigueur, autonomie, communication proactive des difficultés. Un plus Anglais technique (échanges écrits avec des fournisseurs étrangers). Mise en plan, notions de matériaux et d’isolation thermique. Expérience en pression ou température. Formation et expérience Diplôme d’ingénieur (bac +5) en mécanique, génie physique, instrumentation ou mesures physiques. Un parcours associant mécanique et mesures physiques (BUT Mesures physiques puis école d’ingénieurs en mécanique) est particulièrement apprécié. Environ 5 ans d’expérience en conception d’équipements, bureau d’études ou R&D ; profils plus juniors étudiés. Poste orienté conception et terrain : une thèse n’est pas requise. Conditions Sur site. Manutention occasionnelle de pièces métalliques lourdes avec moyens de levage. Intéressement Rémunération : 36 – 48 k€ brut annuel selon expérience Benefits Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&D menés pour des clients internationaux. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle, sur des sujets techniques exigeants au service des énergies du sous-sol et de la transition énergétique. title: Systemadministrator (m/w/d) - Microsoft 365 & Windows Server
description: Dein Einstieg bei Deeken Technology Du willst IT nicht nur betreiben, sondern Verantwortung übernehmen - für Systeme und für die Menschen, die damit arbeiten? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Deeken Technology ist ein etabliertes IT-Systemhaus aus dem Oldenburger Münsterland - seit über 10 Jahren am Markt, mit einem motivierten und engagierten Team. Wir betreuen mittelständische Unternehmen ganzheitlich: IT-Infrastruktur, IT-Sicherheit, Digitalisierung und Telekommunikation. Dabei verkaufen wir keine Einmal-Lösungen, sondern sind langfristiger IT-Partner unserer Kunden - wir kennen ihre Systeme, ihre Abläufe und ihre Ansprechpartner. Für unser Team in unseren neuen Büros im ecopark Emstek suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Systemadministrator (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft - unbefristet, in Vollzeit mit 39 Stunden und hybrid. Deine Aufgaben Bei uns ist jeder Spezialist in seinem Fachgebiet - niemand muss alles können. Dein Schwerpunkt sind die Microsoft-Umgebungen unserer Kunden, vom Serverraum bis in die Cloud. - Du installierst, aktualisierst und betreust Domänencontroller sowie File- und Anwendungsserver - On-Premise und in Cloud-Umgebungen. - Du administrierst Microsoft 365, insbesondere Exchange Online, Entra ID und Intune. - Du richtest Clients ein und erstellst dafür die passenden Intune-Richtlinien und Bereitstellungspläne. - Du installierst Fachanwendungen unserer Kunden wie ERP- oder Dokumentenmanagement-Systeme, begleitest Updates und stimmst dich dabei mit den Softwareherstellern ab. - Du bindest Kundeninfrastrukturen in unser Monitoring ein - damit wir Probleme erkennen, bevor unsere Kunden sie bemerken. - Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Kollegen aus den anderen Fachbereichen zusammen, erklärst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich und dokumentierst sauber in unserer Service-Plattform Hindeo. Das bringst du mit Fachwissen ist wichtig - Haltung entscheidet. Zwei Dinge sind uns deshalb bei jeder Einstellung besonders wichtig: Du kommunizierst klar und gern, mit Kunden genauso wie im Team. Und du übernimmst Verantwortung: Was du anfängst, bringst du zu Ende. - Eine abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung, z. B. als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation - Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Administration von Windows Server und Active Directory, idealerweise in einem Systemhaus - Fundierte Praxis mit Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Entra ID und Intune - Wünschenswert: Virtualisierung (Proxmox), Netzwerkgrundlagen - Eine strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und Freude an wechselnden Kundenumgebungen - Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie einen Führerschein der Klasse B Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt zu 100 Prozent, aber passt menschlich und fachlich im Kern? Dann bewirb dich trotzdem - wir sprechen lieber einmal mehr miteinander. Warum Deeken Technology - Dein eigener Firmenwagen: Nach der Probezeit stellen wir dir einen inkl. Privatnutzung Firmenwagen zur Verfügung. - Dein Fitnessstudio-Abo: Für deinen Ausgleich zum Job bekommst du von uns ein Fitnessabo. - Software, die wir selbst bauen: Wir arbeiten mit Hindeo, unserer eigenen IT-Service-Plattform. In den letzten zwölf Monaten komplett neu entwickelt, gehört sie zu den modernsten Lösungen für Systemhäuser - und dein Feedback fließt direkt in die Weiterentwicklung ein. - Sicherheit mit Anspruch: Als eines der wenigen IT-Unternehmen der Region sind wir nach ISO 27001 zertifiziert. Du arbeitest nach Standards, auf die du stolz sein kannst. - Herstellerschulungen: Je nach Bedarf und Interesse absolvierst du Schulungen unserer Produktpartner, z. B. Hornetsecurity, WatchGuard, IONOS Cloud und CrowdStrike. - Neues Büro im ecopark: Knapp 500 m² im OM-Medienhaus - hell, klimatisiert, mit kontrollierter Belüftung, barrierefrei und mit Mensa im Haus. Getränke, Snacks und ein frischer Obstkorb stehen für dich bereit. - Ankommen ohne Stress: Kostenlose Parkplätze direkt am Haus. Für Elektrofahrzeuge stehen E-Ladesäulen bereit. - Top-Ausstattung: Aktuellste Hardware, Firmenlaptop, Firmenhandy und Home-Office-Ausstattung. - Hybrid & flexibel: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und nach der Einarbeitung ein Tag mobiles Arbeiten pro Woche. - Extras: Edenred und Mitarbeiterrabatte. - Familie & Beruf: Über die Kita-Kooperation im ecopark stehen in einem benachbarten Kindergarten reservierte Plätze für Kinder von Beschäftigten im ecopark zur Verfügung. - Sicherheit & Miteinander: Unbefristeter Vertrag, 28 Urlaubstage, flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, lockerer Dresscode sowie gemeinsame Teamevents - vom Stoppelmarkt über das Cityfest bis zur Weihnachtsfeier. Deine ersten Monate - Ankommen: Du lernst dein Team, unsere Prozesse, Hindeo und unsere ISO-27001-Standards kennen und begleitest erfahrene Kollegen zu ersten Kundeneinsätzen. - Loslegen: Schritt für Schritt übernimmst du eigene Aufgaben in den Microsoft-Umgebungen unserer Kunden und absolvierst deine ersten Herstellerschulungen. - Verantwortung übernehmen: Nach der Einarbeitung verantwortest du die Microsoft-Themen in unseren Kundenumgebungen eigenständig - als Spezialist in einem Team, in dem jeder seine Stärken einbringt. Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich über den Button - ein Lebenslauf reicht für den Anfang. Versprochen: Innerhalb von 3 Werktagen bekommst du eine persönliche Rückmeldung von uns. Purpose of Position

Awin's Legal team advises the group on its legal rights and obligations across a global affiliate and partnership network. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will be a trusted, hands-on partner to our commercial, product and leadership teams, leading complex negotiations, supporting M&A and strategic transactions, and helping the business grow across Europe, the UK, the US and beyond. You will report directly to the General Counsel.

We are looking for a pragmatic, business-enabling lawyer who enjoys solving problems, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is excited about how AI is changing both our industry and the way legal teams work. If you enjoy working across cultures and jurisdictions, join us full-time in one of our hubs, London or Berlin, or work from another country where Awin has an office – you can choose.

Key Tasks

  • Leading the drafting, review and negotiation of complex, high-value commercial agreements with advertisers, publishers, agencies, technology partners and vendors, including MSAs, SaaS and platform terms, partnership agreements, DPAs and NDAs
  • Acting as the go-to legal partner for commercial teams across regions, giving consistent, risk-weighted and business-focused advice that helps close deals
  • Advising on cross-jurisdictional corporate, commercial, competition, intellectual property and regulatory matters under EU, UK, US and other international legal frameworks
  • Supporting M&A and strategic transactions end to end, from due diligence and transaction documents to corporate approvals and post-merger integration
  • Managing disputes, litigation and third-party information requests such as subpoenas, together with external counsel
  • Working with the Privacy team on the commercial and contractual side of data protection, including GDPR, UK GDPR, US state privacy laws and other regimes
  • Shaping how Legal uses AI: introducing AI tools and workflows that make the team more efficient, and advising the business on the legal aspects of AI, including the EU AI Act
  • Improving templates, playbooks and legal processes, and delivering practical training to non-lawyers

Skills & Expertise

  • Qualified as a solicitor or barrister in England and Wales and/or admitted to practise as an attorney in a US state
  • 5+ years' post-qualification experience, ideally in-house in an international business or at a law firm handling comparable commercial work
  • Strong track record in complex commercial negotiations, ideally in affiliate or performance marketing, or in a related sector such as tech, SaaS, AdTech or e-commerce; experience with US commercial contracts, litigation, subpoenas and dispute resolution is a plus
  • Solid M&A experience, including due diligence, transaction documentation and post-closing integration
  • Working knowledge of data protection laws such as GDPR, UK GDPR and US state privacy laws is an advantage
  • Native or native-level English, with excellent drafting and communication skills and the ability to explain complex legal, technical and business matters clearly to non-lawyers; additional languages such as Spanish, French or Portuguese are a plus
  • A keen interest in AI and confidence using AI tools in your daily work, with an eye for how they can make legal work faster and better; knowledge of AI regulation and governance, such as the EU AI Act, is a plus

  • Strong organisation and prioritisation skills: you manage several matters at once, work independently and keep quality high under tight deadlines and constant change; experience with contract management systems, Asana or other legal tools is welcome
  • A collaborative team player who builds strong relationships across functions and regions

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures. Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination. What sets us apart What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected. When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture. What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog . Meet the team behind this journey You will join the Hybrid Platform Engineering track, which builds and operates the compute layer underpinning DeepL's products and research: the Kubernetes control plane, node lifecycle, networking, storage and core cluster services, across both on-prem and cloud infrastructure. Today that spans hybrid infrastructure in Europe - including large on-prem GPU clusters powering DeepL's research and hundreds of on-prem GPU nodes serving production inference - as well as AWS regions across the globe running the product. The track is deepening this hybrid model, unifying how workloads run across on-prem hardware and AWS to give product and research teams a self-service foundation they can build on. Your responsibilities Take ownership of the reliability, capacity and cost efficiency of DeepL's compute infrastructure, CPU and GPU: the hybrid platform serving our products across AWS and on-prem, and the on-prem clusters powering our research, including their hardware lifecycle Shape the platform's architecture: bring strong technical positions, weigh them on their merits with your peers, and commit to decisions serving the best outcome Design, build and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters across cloud and on-prem infrastructure, taking them from design through to long-term operation Drive the technical work of deepening the hybrid model - unifying how workloads run across on-prem hardware and cloud, especially AWS and supporting research as it adopts cloud-native technology and ways of working Define infrastructure-as-code and platform standards that hold across the track, and strengthen observability and security so the platform's behaviour is legible to the teams that depend on it Mentor engineers across the infrastructure track and raise the technical bar of the group, through design reviews, architecture decisions and the everyday habits that keep the platform maintainable Build consensus across engineering teams and turn it into shipped change, shaping platform direction at track level Lead incident response for hybrid infrastructure, driving remediation through to root cause, and help sustain an on-call rotation the team can carry for the long term What you bring to the table Deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise: you have designed, built and operated clusters at scale, through their full lifecycle Depth at scale in either public cloud or on-prem infrastructure, plus the credibility to work in the other. AWS experience is preferred, and bare-metal or data centre experience is strongly valued Networking and Linux depth you can debug with: you can follow a problem from a container through the host to the network edge Infrastructure as code with Terraform or equivalent, and GitOps delivery with tooling such as ArgoCD, applied to environments you have owned in production Software engineering skills in at least one major language, Go or Python preferred, at the level of building tooling other engineers rely on A track record of technical ownership spanning several teams: you create clarity where a mandate crosses team boundaries, hold clear technical positions, change them on evidence and carry other engineers with you Strong incident-management and reliability-engineering discipline, and the ownership mindset to build more resilient systems You’d get bonus points for GPU infrastructure for training or inference at scale Distributed storage systems in production, such as Ceph Having served researchers or data scientists as platform customers Networking at BGP level in a hybrid or on-prem environment What we offer: Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network. Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together. Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team's general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration. Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future. Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally. Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity. 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally. Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way. If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply, let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you! #LI-VO1 We are an equal opportunity employer You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.   • Design, build and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters across cloud and on-prem infrastructure, taking them from design through to long-term operation

  • Mentor engineers across the infrastructure track and raise the technical bar of the group, through design reviews, architecture decisions and the everyday habits that keep the platform maintainable

  • Build consensus across engineering teams and turn it into shipped change, shaping platform direction at track level

  • Lead incident response for hybrid infrastructure, driving remediation through to root cause, and help sustain an on-call rotation the team can carry for the long term

  • Depth at scale in either public cloud or on-prem infrastructure, plus the credibility to work in the other. AWS experience is preferred, and bare-metal or data centre experience is strongly valued

  • Networking and Linux depth you can debug with: you can follow a problem from a container through the host to the network edge

  • Infrastructure as code with Terraform or equivalent, and GitOps delivery with tooling such as ArgoCD, applied to environments you have owned in production

  • GPU infrastructure for training or inference at scale

  • Distributed storage systems in production, such as Ceph

  • Having served researchers or data scientists as platform customers

  • Networking at BGP level in a hybrid or on-prem environment

We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team's general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

raw.title: Revenue Operations Manager
raw.description:
We're unlocking access to the NHS, because healthcare is not truly free until it's truly accessible 💙

The world’s best healthcare, for free. It's not a new idea, it's called the NHS. But the largest healthcare provider is fundamentally broken. Patient satisfaction is at an all time low, and the biggest reason cited is lack of access. So we’re on a mission to fix it with technology that actually works.

We're building the front door of UK healthcare, creating a future where one billion NHS appointments are transparent and instantly bookable, and patients are guided to the right service first time using AI.

We're developing critical national infrastructure. Today, 26% of GP practices in England use our patient registration software, while one in five GP practices in London use Bookable Search to help new patients find and book appointments seamlessly.

Our latest product, Bookable Navigator, extends this vision by automatically booking appointments for existing patients.

We operate from within a working GP practice in East London 🏥 We're backed by Y Combinator, Innovate UK and the NHS Clinical Entrepreneur Programme, and were previously ranked the 8th fastest-growing startup in the UK and 33rd fastest-growing in Europe 🚀

⛩️ Our Principles

Exciting challenges lie ahead. Guided by our principles, we’ll meet these challenges with a thoughtful and caring approach. These principles drive everything we do at Healthtech-1:

  1. 💙 Care deeply

  2. 🏋️‍♀️ Work hard

  3. 🤝 Be your word

  4. 💬 Trust in radical truth and transparency

  5.  🚀 Do your life's best work

  6. 🥳 Find the fun

Read more about our principles and our "why" in the Healthtech-1 Handbook.

🎯 Goal expectations

As our Revenue Operations Manager, you’ll own the tooling and data that let’s Healthtech-1 scale across the NHS.

You’ll work closely across the GTM teams, deploy internal tooling with AI, turn Attio into our source of truth, and build an intelligent GTM motion on top.

This is an IC role, not a people management role. One week you might be rolling your sleeves up with the growth team, to be one or two steps ahead in identifying what the team need to hit their targets, and building internal tooling with AI to support the team. The next week you might be deep in the data, bringing company-wide data sources together to aide growth strategy planning e.g. identifying high demand areas in our marketplace, where we need to increase supply.

Objective 1: Keep systems and data running at a high standard

You will own and maintain Attio (our CRM), including its infrastructure, workflows and data hygiene across accounts and products. You will also own all our GTM tooling (e.g. Aircall, Calendly, Granola) and keep them running and improving. You will build a lot of tooling yourself using AI (e.g. dashboard, maps). You will run practice enrichment and data scraping pipelines so our data on customers stays current and usable.

Objective 2: Give the team and leadership clear visibility

You will build and maintain dashboards tracking company growth, cycle targets and product adoption. You will own reporting on practice numbers and growth trends. You will maintain tracking so leadership always has clear visibility on where deals are at.

Objective 3: Enable the growth team to sell more

The Growth team are your customer. You will build and maintain quality lead lists for AEs. You will support AEs with operational queries, targets and tooling. You will help new growth hires ramp faster through better tooling and playbooks.

Objective 4: Drive operational improvement

You will find and build automations and workflow improvements that save the team time. You will spot friction in how the growth team operates and fix it. You will actively look for ways to help the team drive more revenue.

⚠️ This role is not for everyone

This is a high-ownership, high-expectation role. You'll be working in a fast-moving healthtech environment where accuracy, speed, and proactivity all matter at the same time.

You probably won't enjoy this role if you:

  • Prefer to be told what to do over figuring out what to do

  • Treat ops as a support function rather than a growth lever

  • Aren't comfortable getting your hands dirty with data

  • Are content to maintain the status quo rather than improve it

  • Have never built things with AI

You will enjoy this role if you like owning systems end-to-end, building and deploying things with AI, and making the people around you more effective.

👍 Required experience

  • 2+ years in a revenue operations role in an early-stage startup, where you've owned systems, data and process improvement

  • Experience with Attio (or similar CRMs like HubSpot, Salesforce)

✅ Must-have traits

  • Great with AI - you know how to leverage AI well, whilst thoroughly checking accuracy

  • Detail oriented - you’re obsessed with the detail and CRM being the source of truth

  • Love data - you can build dashboards, spot trends, and make data useful for decision-making

  • Proactive problem solver - you don't wait for someone to flag a problem; you find it and fix it end-to-end.

  • Bias to action - you ship improvements quickly rather than over-planning

  • Team player - low ego, approachable and feedback-oriented; you get a kick from seeing the impact your work has on unlocking the sales team

  • Clear communicator - you keep stakeholders informed without being chased

💙 Desired traits

  • Comfortable with data scraping, enrichment tools and light automation (e.g. Zapier, Make, scripts)

  • Experience building dashboards and reports (e.g. Metabase, Looker, Google Sheets)

  • Familiarity with sales tooling (Calendly, Aircall, or equivalents)

  • Experience writing operational playbooks or onboarding materials

😊 The hiring process (4 stages)

  • 👋 Intro chat - with our Talent Partner, to learn more about each other

  • 📝 Take home task - complete a short task

  • 💼 An in-office work trial - work with the growth team on a real problem [1 day, fully paid]

  • ⛩️ Principles interview - with a Founder, to understand that our values align

  • 🎉 Offer!

💙 A bit about us

💙 We’re all NHS staff. We’re inside-outsiders. Trusted with one of the biggest datasets in the world.

🏥 Our office is within a GP practice. This is our unfair advantage. Got a question? Pop down the corridor. Want to learn how your work affects real patients? Pop downstairs to reception.

💪🏼 4 days in the office and 1 day WFH (for most roles). We highly prioritise in-person communication and prefer candidates who want to work 4+ days a week in the office. Our anchor days are Mon, Tues, Thurs and Fri. Homemade breakfast and lunch are on the house every day when you're in the office, ensuring you're fuelled for success!

🌀 We work in growth cycles. Every 8 weeks we do the same set of activities. 1 week outside of Business-as-Usual to research, strategise, plan our work. 7 weeks to knuckle down and deliver it.

🤝 We’re highly collaborative. One of the benefits of a high trust team is we often work autonomously, but as a team we’re very collaborative by nature. Two heads are often better than one, and we frequently lean on each other to solve problems together.

🤜🏽 We’re backed by industry leaders. We’re on the DigitalHealth.London Accelerator, backed by the NHS Clinical Entrepreneur Program, winners of the London Business School Healthtech Challenge, Innovate UK, and Y Combinator (S23).

🚀 An opportunity for real upside

💉 Paid volunteer days. We offer an additional 2 paid days off per year where you can give back to your mission of choice.

🎢 Every 8 weeks we take a day off to socialise as a team. In the past we’ve hiked box hill, raved at All Points East and spent one rainy day at Thorpe park. This works out as 6 working days a year.

📚 Learning budget of £250 annually and time off to spend it - we care about this; this is flexible and based on need but everyone will receive a yearly allocation towards their continual growth.

🍽️ Homemade breakfast and lunch are on the house when you're in the office, ensuring you're fuelled for success!

🥡 Team takeaways every Monday night

🥗 Health and fitness budget of £60 per month - see more here

🧘‍♂️ An additional 7 days of paid leave is available if you want to take time to learn how to meditate.

💫 Tooling; You’ll have your choice of operating systems and any additional tools you need to do your best work (e.g. keyboard, additional monitors, mouse etc). If you’re on our Engineering teams you’ll receive the latest MacBook Pro and our Growth & Ops teams receives a MacBook Air.

🩺 We know health and family come first which is why we have a generous sick leave policy with additional days that can be taken for mental health leave.

✈️ We prioritise time outside of work to bond, once a year we’ll holiday together! Destination chosen by popular vote. In 2025, we spent 8 days in a surf camp in France!

👎 No private medical insurance, because we believe in the NHS and we are here to improve it!

🐥 Parental leave: Post passing probation it is: statutory - 6 weeks 90% pay then, SMP for 33 weeks; if you've been an employee for a year: 12 weeks 100% pay then, SMP for 27 weeks; and if you have been here for 2 years: 18 weeks 100% pay then, SMP for 21 weeks. This will improve over time. We also include up to £9,000 of childcare contribution for primary caregivers to support a five-day return where possible.

👪 Fertility leave. We understand how difficult a fertility journey can be. This is why we give an extra 5 days off per year if you or your partner are going through fertility treatment.

🐖 Pension - We operate a standard 3% employer contribution and employees auto-contribute 5% of their salary. We use Nest as our provider.

🏡 Local living benefit - A one-off benefit to support living closer to the office: £5,000 if you live within a 30-minute walk, or £2,500 within a 30-minute bike. It is optional, available immediately on signing, and not linked to performance or progression.

🚕 If you choose to work late in the office, you can expense dinner after 7pm and an Uber home after 9pm, or earlier if you feel unsafe travelling in the dark. This is optional and about wellbeing, not performance or expectations.

⛵️And of course, an adventure of a lifetime!

🌈 Inclusive & Diverse by Design

We care about building a product that is loved and a culture that is rich in perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds.

Our team represents more than ten different cultures. We come together every lunch time for a home cooked meal, rotated among team members!

We want everyone in our team to know that they belong. We are purposeful about this and are proactively building a company that is inclusive of all people; from race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, neurodiversity, disability, colour, and national origin - essentially every type of diversity. We don’t just want people who fit in, we want them to fit together. We're active in continually improving the way we make this happen.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Team Agent
description: About the role Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Agent team. We are building a platform for creating, publishing, and executing AI-powered agents that help teams automate complex workflows in financial services. The Agents team owns the agent execution runtime, tool orchestration, and platform infrastructure that makes this possible, including the conversational copilot experiences built on top of it across the product. We are hiring a Full-Stack Engineer to help build and ship production features across this entire stack, from the agent runtime and tool orchestration layer in the backend, to the conversational copilot experiences users interact with every day. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, contribute to real product impact from day one, and grow your skills in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment. What You'll Do Build and ship features end-to-end for Taktile's AI agent platform: backend in Python (FastAPI) on AWS serverless infrastructure, and frontend in React and TypeScript. Build conversational copilot experiences end to end: chat UI components, streaming responses, rich in-chat interactions, and human-in-the-loop approvals. Improve how agents run, how they connect to external tools, and how they behave when something goes wrong. Own your work end-to-end: collaborate on scope, implement, test, release, and iterate based on real usage and customer feedback. Use leading-edge AI tools (e.g. Claude) on a daily basis to move faster, improve quality, and build AI-native capabilities where it makes sense. Review pull requests with depth, improve test coverage and CI/CD, and raise the bar on reliability and engineering excellence. Engage actively in team rituals such as daily syncs, planning sessions, demos, and technical deep-dive discussions. Grow as an individual and accelerate your career by learning from experienced team members, contributing to a foundational layer of the product, and joining cross-team learning groups. For career growth at Taktile, this role will involve daytime ops duty and at some point joining an on-call rotation, so you need to have passion for owning systems end to end and grow your DevSecOps skills as well. Team's tech stack Backend: Python (FastAPI, Pydantic) Frontend: React, TypeScript Data: DynamoDB, Postgres Cloud: AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway) AI: LLM orchestration, tool-use frameworks, streaming execution Requirements Strong engineering fundamentals with a passion for simplicity and precision. Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is essential as we operate in an hybrid environment requiring clear and effective communication. Strong English skills are also crucial to efficiently interacting with AI. Prior industry experience building full-stack web applications (this is not an entry-level position). Proficiency with React and TypeScript, and experience building rich, interactive user interfaces. Experience with Python back-end development, building and operating RESTful APIs, and working with databases. Experience integrating into AWS or similar cloud providers. Nice but not required Experience building chat or conversational UIs, real-time/streaming interfaces, or data visualization. FastAPI and Pydantic experience. DynamoDB or Postgres, SQLAlchemy. Exposure to LLM application development, agent frameworks, MCP, or building developer tools. Prior ops or on-call experience. Experience with distributed systems, async task processing, or observability tooling (tracing, metrics, logging). Our Offer Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here. Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo. Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe. Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package. Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes. Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up. Our Stance We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply. We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears. About Us Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com . About Your Employment . Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). The applicable entity will be confirmed during the offer process. Your Privacy . Taktile (“we” or “us”) is the controller of the personal data you provide during this application process. Working knowledge of EU consent and privacy: GDPR, consent mode, iOS App Tracking Transparency, and how push permissions behave on iOS and Android. Experimentation: framing hypotheses, choosing and configuring metrics, judging when a result is real. Precise writing: specs that engineers (and AI coding agents) can start on without a meeting, and concise updates and decision memos for leadership. description: Team Lead Sales Development (m/w/d), Player-Coach für 5 bis 8 SDRs bei einer Sales-as-a-Service Agentur in Berlin Intro Die meisten Teamlead-Rollen suchen jemanden, der Dashboards anschaut. Hier sieht dein Team dich selbst telefonieren. Unser Kunde baut und betreibt B2B Outbound für Firmen, die kein eigenes Sales-Team aufbauen können oder wollen. Sales-as-a-Service aus Kreuzberg, 20+ Leute aus Sales und KI, backed by einem Health-VC und einem Berliner Family Office. Dazu eigene KI-Modelle auf eigenen Daten und Elite-Partner eines großen Cloud-Telefonie-Anbieters. Die Mandate reichen vom Weltkonzern bis zum Stealth-Startup, dazu US-Firmen beim Markteintritt in Deutschland. Die Teamlead-Rolle hat gerade höchste Priorität. Das Paket: 60k EUR Fix, OTE bis 100k, Bonus ungedeckelt, Berlin hybrid ohne starre Office-Policy. Tasks Du führst ein Team von 5 bis 8 SDRs, das für Kunden Termine bucht. Rund 70% Führung: Coaching, Call-Reviews, Kampagnensteuerung, Reporting. Rund 30% operativ: Du bleibst selbst am Telefon und springst rein, wo es brennt. Die Mandate: Smart Building und Gebäudetechnik, KI-Softwareentwicklung, Fördermittel, Deep Tech, Sondermaschinenbau, Stadtwerke, internationale Sales-Tech-Plattformen. Du hast täglich Kundenkontakt, auch mit CEOs und Head ofs. Der typische Moment: Ein CEO, der für Outbound bezahlt, will wissen, warum diese Woche weniger Termine kamen als geplant. Du erklärst es mit Zahlen und verkaufst den nächsten Schritt. Eigene Kundenprojekte: Du setzt neue Mandate auf (ICP, Liste, Messaging, Kadenz) und richtest das Team darauf aus. Internationale Projekte wie US-Markteintritte landen oft genau bei den Teamleads. Du steuerst über Calls, Connect Rate, Meetings und Show Rate pro SDR und weißt, an welchem Hebel du drehst. Stack: Clay, Lemlist, n8n, Attio, Placetel, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, plus eine eigene KI-Unit mit automatisierter Recherche und KI-Call-Coaching. Requirements Du warst selbst SDR und hast kalt telefoniert. Du weißt, wie sich der 60. Call am Tag anfühlt, und genau daher kommt deine Glaubwürdigkeit als Coach. Mindestens 1 Jahr echte Führungserfahrung als Teamlead im B2B. Reines B2C reicht hier nicht. Wenn ein SDR seit Wochen unter Ziel liegt, hast du einen Plan: Call-Review, Roleplay, 1:1, und wenn nötig auch die Konsequenz. Vor einem CEO bleibst du ruhig, klar und hast die Zahlen parat, gerade in einer schlechten Woche. Nicht für alles gibt es einen Prozess. Du baust mit, statt dich an Zuständigkeiten festzuhalten. Fix: fließend Deutsch, Wohnort Berlin. Ehrlich gesagt: Wenn du heute Head of bist und dieses Level halten willst, ist das eine Ebene zu tief. Und wer nur noch steuern und nicht mehr telefonieren will, ist hier falsch. Ein Abschluss oder ein großes Logo im Lebenslauf sind nicht das Tor, deine Team-Zahlen schon. Benefits 60k EUR Fix, OTE bis 100k, Bonus ungedeckelt. Das Fixum ist bewusst moderat, der Bonus ist der Hebel für alle, die mit ihrem Team Leistung bringen wollen. Perspektive: mehr Verantwortung über eigene Kundenprojekte und größere Teams, Richtung Project Lead mit Verantwortung für Kundenaccounts und SDR-Teams. Lernkurve: Mandate quer durch Branchen, vom Konzern bis zum Stealth-Startup, plus internationale Markteintritte. Nach 12 Monaten setzt du ein Outbound-Projekt in jeder Branche von null auf und bringst ein Team darauf. Coaching mit Daten statt Bauchgefühl: KI-Recherche und KI-Call-Coaching aus der hauseigenen KI-Unit machen deine SDRs schneller besser. Hybrid ohne starre Policy: Office am Moritzplatz, viel Präsenz ist erwünscht, ein Monat von woanders ist in der Regel drin. Junges Team im Startup-Modus, in dem alle noch selbst reinspringen, auch die Gründer. Closing Klingt nach dir? Die Bewerbung dauert zwei Minuten, kein Motivationsschreiben. So läuft’s: Bewerbung ➝ Talent Call mit uns ➝ ca. 30 Min Screening digital ➝ Fachgespräch zu Führung und Praxis, voraussichtlich mit Cold Call oder Führungs-Case ➝ Meet the Team vor Ort in Berlin, das Team hat Veto ➝ Entscheidung und Offer. Warum über GENZ4GTM: Vor jedem Kundengespräch bekommst du von uns ein Cheatsheet, nach jeder Runde ehrliches Feedback, und mit einer Bewerbung matchen wir dich auf mehrere passende Rollen. title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
description: Wir bauen humanoide Systeme: Full Stack, von Hardware und Elektronik über Software bis zur Fertigung, alles in-house in Berlin. Bei Cell Labs verschieben wir die Grenze dessen, was Robotik leisten kann. Unser Ziel ist klar: Systeme bauen, die Menschen stärken statt sie zu ersetzen. Unsere Technologie ist bereits bei führenden Industriekunden und Partnern im Einsatz. Jetzt steht unser eigenes Produkt kurz vor dem Launch. Die leise Phase ist vorbei. Wir suchen Menschen, die früh dabei sein wollen, Verantwortung übernehmen und das bauen, worüber andere nur reden. Ort: Berlin · Start: Ab sofort · Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort · Anstellung : Vollzeit Deine Aufgaben Marketingstrategie & Produktlaunch: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Gründer:innen unsere Marketingstrategie und gestaltest den Launch unserer Produkte aktiv mit, von Messaging über Kampagnen bis zu Events. Partnerschaften & Kooperationen: Du identifizierst, verhandelst und steuerst Marketing-Kooperationen mit Technologiepartnern, Industriekunden und Hochschulen, von der ersten Ansprache bis zu gemeinsamen Projekten und Kampagnen. Go-to-Market: Du planst und steuerst Kampagnen entlang des gesamten Funnels. Über Website, SEO und Content baust du eine Inbound-Maschine, die qualifizierte Leads aus der Industrie bringt, und du unterstützt Outbound mit Zielkundenlisten und passenden Kampagnen. Events: Du entscheidest, welche Messen und Konferenzen für unser Wachstum zählen. Die Marketingseite von Industrieevents liegt bei dir, von Messaging und Lead-Erfassung über das Follow-up bis zu Speaking Slots für das Team. Markt & Wettbewerb: Du beobachtest den Robotik-, Automatisierungs- und Deep-Tech-Markt, erkennst Lücken in der Positionierung und bringst sie in Strategie und Produkt ein. Marketing-KPIs: Du definierst, misst und berichtest die Kennzahlen, die zählen: Pipeline-Beitrag, Conversion, Cost per Lead und Funnel-Entwicklung. Daraus leitest du Entscheidungen ab, statt nur Reports zu verwalten. Sales Enablement: In enger Abstimmung mit den Gründer:innen unterstützt du Vertrieb und Business Development mit Pitch-Material, Use Cases, Case Studies und Produktkommunikation für konkrete Verkaufssituationen. Investorenkommunikation: Du verfasst regelmäßige Investor-Updates und gestaltest die Storyline unseres Pitch Decks mit. Das bringst du mit Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre im Marketing gearbeitet, davon einen Teil in einem Startup oder Scale-up, in dem du Marketing mit aufgebaut hast. Du hast mindestens einen größeren Produktlaunch begleitet und kannst erzählen, was funktioniert hat und was nicht. Neugier: Interesse an komplexen Technologien und die Motivation, tief in die Robotik einzutauchen, technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und verständlich zu vermitteln. title: Product Manager, Homepage
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.
  • Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.
  • Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.
  • Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.
  • You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.
  • You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.
  • You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.
  • You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.
  • You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).
  • You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

  • Lead multi-disciplinary teams, bringing together expertise from across Baringa​

  • Strong technical grounding in AI and automation – such as generative and agentic AI, process mining and low-code workflow platforms – and in the data, evaluation and controls needed to run them in production​

  • Experience in business development and in delivering work in at least one of Baringa’s industry sectors​
  • Strong senior stakeholder relationship, communication and presentation skills, with business, technical and executive audiences​
  • Experience coaching teams and delivering training to colleagues and clients​
  • Ability to travel for up to 50% of the time, and to travel and work within the EU/UK​

  • Certifications or delivery experience in AI and automation platforms such as Azure AI, AWS, Celonis, Power Platform, ServiceNow or Pega​

An award-winning workplace

  • Helping clients identify and explore where AI and automation could add value, shaping practical use cases and supporting early adoption 
  • Designing and delivering business and transformation programmes, incorporating digital tools, analytics and automation where appropriate 
  • Supporting organisations to monetise digital products, content and platforms, using data and insight to inform growth decisions 
  • Improving customer, partner and user experience across end‑to‑end journeys through digital and data‑enabled change 
  • Designing future operating models, considering how people, processes and technology (including automation) work together 
  • Supporting organisations through business model evolution (e.g. telco to techco, content to platform, product to ecosystem) 
  • Advising on M&A, integration and carve‑outs, supporting value creation through better insight, execution discipline and change delivery. 
  • Working across adjacent TMT areas such as media, platforms, data centres, hyperscalers and digital infrastructure 

 
Your skills and experience 
 

We recruit people at all levels based on merit. While our team members typically have excellent academic achievements, we are looking for 'street smart' as well as 'book smart'. Don’t worry about ‘ticking boxes’ if you’ve got the consulting skills and knowledge we are after, we would love to talk to you.  

We are interested in consultants with experience across parts of the Telecommunications, Media and Technology (TMT) ecosystem, who combine strong consulting fundamentals with curiosity about how digital, data, automation and AI are shaping organisations. 

This may include experience or interest in areas such as: 

  • TMT value chains, including telecoms, media, platforms, content, data and technology‑enabled businesses 
  • Digital products and services, platform and ecosystem business models 
  • The application of data, automation and AI to commercial performance, operations or customer experience 
  • Data and MI environments, including dashboards, performance management and decision support 
  • Commercial and growth models, including pricing, monetisation and partnerships 
  • Awareness of emerging technologies influencing TMT, such as cloud, GenAI, platforms and digital infrastructure 

Alongside this knowledge, we look for strong consulting skills and a delivery mindset, including: 

  • Experience supporting strategy and transformation delivery within TMT organisations 
  • Exposure and experience of delivering end‑to‑end change, not just stand‑alone analysis 
  • Comfort working alongside digital tools, data and AI, without needing to be a technical specialist 
  • Strong data literacy - able to interpret insights and translate them into clear recommendations 
  • Clear communication skills, particularly when explaining digital or AI‑related concepts to non‑technical stakeholders 
  • A strong focus on outcomes, execution and impact

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

At Anduril Australia we are developing unmanned systems for subsurface and other domains that will leverage unsupervised autonomy for the delivery of long endurance, multi-mission capability to our customers. These projects, including but not limited to the Extra Large Autonomous Undersea Vehicle (XL-AUV) Program, require Mechanical Engineers with broad experience to drive the delivery a variety of software enabled hardware capabilities to our customers. Anduril Mechanical Engineers rapidly develop expertise in new domains in order to architect, design, deliver, support, and evolve next generation capabilities through the entire product life-cycle.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Creating detailed plans and specifications for new designs, or derivatives of the Anduril Extra Large Autonomous Undersea Vehicles (XL-AUVs).
  • Creating detailed mechanical designs, prototypes and build of complex structures and mechanisms.
  • Simulation and analysis of mechanical designs including modal/spectral response analysis.
  • Ensure all designs meet internal and external maritime standards.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for your areas of expertise as they relate to the delivery of Anduril technology capabilities, including areas such as part design, analysis and material selection.
  • Inspecting parts, sub-systems and vehicles to meet design specifications and regulations.
  • Design and implement integrated systems, including advanced and sensitive platforms and payloads, that rapidly delivers capability beyond the scope of current systems, with a clear path for both architecture and capability evolution over time.
  • Empathise with end-users and drive solutions that balance their needs with external constraints, restrictions and requirements in a multi-stakeholder environment.
  • Contribute to the design and development of technology components across Anduril, with the aim of developing components that are re-usable across multiple Anduril product lines.
  • Contribute to the design, implementation and execution of development processes for the initial delivery and subsequent iteration of structural hardware, including full lifecycle testing, monitoring and operation.
  • Support vehicle and payload manufacturing, testing and deployment. Including DVT (Design Validation Testing) of parts and sub systems.
  • Travel to co-locate with end-users, vendors, or the integration and test team up to 20% of the time.
  • Work as a member of a multi-disciplinary engineering team, including as a mentor for more Junior Engineers from differing backgrounds.

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace, Naval Architecture, a relevant field, or equivalent experience.
  • Professional experience working as a Mechanical Engineer with one or more domains and/or technologies of expertise.
  • Capacity to work holistically on complex mechanical systems and structures across design, implementation, operation and sustainment.
  • Capacity to act as the technical owner for a complex structural components and assemblies, including stakeholder engagement, requirements definition, roadmap management, team co-ordination, design, implementation, sustainment and evolution.
  • Capacity to learn and grow individually while being part of a dynamic team, building cohesion and capacity.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Security Clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Experience with the design, analysis, testing, implementation and support of mechanical parts and assemblies.
  • Experience working within the maritime defence domains or similar industry e.g. Aerospace or Automotive.
  • Experience with NX, FEMAP and Teamcenter or similar CAD, FEA and PLM systems.
  • Experience developing Finite Element Method (FEM) models for the purposes of part stress and strain evaluation, and modal analysis.
  • Experience with welding, machining, sheet metal, injection molding, composites and/or additive manufacturing.
  • Experience within the product delivery lifecycle including manufacturing, system acceptance, deployment, and sustainment.

The UK Growth team owns how Anduril builds and converts opportunity in the UK, from market engagement and capture through to contract. title: Senior People Business Partner
description:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About the People and Culture Team

The Mixpanel People team exists to help every employee do their best work. We build the structure and support that enables a high-performing organization to move fast without losing what makes us Mixpanel - connection, candor, and the values we hold each other to.

A core driver of Mixpanel's success is investing in our people and clearing the way for individuals and teams of every background to reach their full potential. The People function leads that work - executing our people strategy, advising senior leadership, and running HR operations with the rigor a high-performing company demands.

Within that team, this role owns the EMEA go-to-market population specifically — three offices (London, Barcelona, and Tel Aviv) growing fast enough that the programs supporting them are still being built, not just maintained.

About the Role

This is a hybrid role based in London, supporting Mixpanel's EMEA business across our London, Barcelona, and Israel offices, embedded with our Go-To-Market leadership team. You'll report to our Global Head of HR Business Partners and operate as a strategic, trusted advisor to EMEA GTM leadership - shaping programs and policy, not just executing them.

This is a multi-country role by design. Your GTM population sits across the UK, Spain, and Israel, so working knowledge of employment law and practice in all three is essential - the right call in one market is often the wrong call in another. Experience supporting teams in APAC is a strong plus as our footprint there grows, but it isn't required.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary People Business Partner for Mixpanel's EMEA GTM leadership team, operating as a strategic, trusted advisor on org design, workforce planning, and talent strategy.
  • Proactively coach and partner with GTM people managers and leaders across EMEA to build, lead, and grow high-performing teams.
  • Lead complex, multi-country change initiatives — reorgs, comp cycles, policy rollouts — from strategy through communication, partnering with stakeholders to build buy-in rather than just announcing outcomes.
  • Investigate and resolve employee relations matters across the UK, Spain, and Israel, balancing legal risk, company principle, and individual dignity.
  • Turn workforce data — attrition, engagement, performance — into a business case leaders act on, not just a report they skim.
  • Collaborate with the broader People team on programs that elevate the employee experience company-wide, bringing an EMEA- and GTM-specific point of view to global design.
  • Maintain fluency in HR principles, practices, and regulatory environments across the UK, Spain, and Israel to recommend policy with confidence.
  • Build automation and AI into your own workflows and the team's — using it to move faster on the transactional work so there's more time for the judgment calls that need a person.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • 8+ years of experience in HR/People roles, including 5+ years as a dedicated People/HR Business Partner, ideally supporting Sales or go-to-market organizations.
  • Working knowledge of employment law and HR practice in the UK, Spain, & Israel — experience in all 3 regions preferred but required in UK & Spain.
  • Deep functional experience in two or more HR areas: talent management, employee relations, employee experience, compensation, organizational development, or HR policy.
  • A track record of leading through ambiguity and owning multi-country problems end to end.
