title: Principal Biostatistician
description:
Position Summary: 

Job Description 

Provides statistical support for all phases of clinical development. Specific responsibilities include writing and reviewing statistical sections of protocols, writing and reviewing statistical analysis plans including complex study designs, conducting statistical analyses and presenting results to project teams and sponsors, and developing SAS programs for tables, listings, figures and analysis datasets in accordance with Precision and/or sponsor procedures or study specific guidelines. 

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to: 

  • Generate and/or verify randomization schedules 
  • Develop and review statistical methods of the clinical study protocol including  complex study designs 
  • Provide and/or verify sample size calculations. Perform or assist with advanced  calculations including adaptive design 
  • Provide input into development of case report forms (CRFs) 
  • Author statistical analysis plans, including development of table, figure and listing  shells, complex study design and late phase 
  • Review statistical analysis plans written by other biostatisticians 
  • Generate analysis datasets, tables, figures, and listings to support the analysis of  clinical trials data using SAS 
  • Perform quality control for statistical based SAS programs and other study documents (e.g., presentations and reports) 
  • Provide or supervise programming and statistical support to supplemental or exploratory analyses for regulatory agencies or any other internal and external ad-hoc requests
  • Ability to serve as a biostatistical consultant to company staff globally, with  understanding of varying regional perspectives 
  • Review output across programs to ensure consistency.
  • Provide statistical analysis and reports to Data Monitoring Committees (DMCs) as the unblinded biostatistician
  • Review statistical sections of clinical study reports
  • Work directly with sponsors, project managers, and external vendors on statistics related project components. Interact directly with study team
  • Interact directly with sponsors
  • Lead all statistical activities for study within timelines
  • Independently perform budget health review on projects and review monthly invoices
  • Perform oversight responsibilities on projects for other biostatisticians
  • Assist with budget development and present at bid defense meetings
  • Participate in the development and maintenance of departmental procedures and  standards (templates, SOPs, WIs etc.)
  • Review study tasks to ensure study being conducted in line with agreed budget;  identify change in scope
  • Other duties as assigned 

Qualifications: 

Minimum Required: 

  • Master's degree or equivalent in Statistics, Biostatistics, or related field with 10+ years experience; PhD degree in Statistics, Biostatistics, or related field with 7+ years experience 

Other Required: 

  • Experience with SAS  
  • Knowledge of industry standards such as the ICH guidelines, CDISC data structures, 21 CFR Part 11, and FDA guidelines 
  • Broad knowledge and superior understanding of advanced statistical concepts and techniques 

Preferred: 

  • Experience with Oncology and rare diseases 
  • Broad experience with late phase and/or submissions 
  • Experience in consulting with clients on study design 
  • Superior understanding of a specific therapeutic area and/or statistical methodology  (eg, adaptive design, missing data) 

Skills:  

  • Mastery of statistical principles underlying clinical trials 
  • Mastery of SAS programming skills and familiarity with other packages 
  • Outstanding statistical skills  
  • Excellent consultative skills 
  • Excellent organizational skills, time management, and ability to coordinate workload and meet established deadlines.  
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interface with others. 
  • Excellent problem-solving skills

Competencies:

  • Service oriented, accountable and flexible

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager – Hardware
description:
Cambridge, UK| Full-time | Permanent | Hybrid

 Salary: £61,500 to £80,000 

About us 

Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved. Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology.  It’s a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion.  

Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and governments to make fault-tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast

About the role 

We are looking for an exceptional Product Marketing Manager to lead the positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy for Deltaflow, our real-time quantum error correction (QEC) system. Deltaflow is a critical component in the quantum computing stack, enabling the ultra-fast data processing and decoding required to correct errors in quantum computers in real time with high accuracy and throughput.

This is a unique opportunity to join a world-leading deep-tech company at a pivotal stage of market development. You will sit at the intersection of engineering, product, customers, and commercial strategy, translating highly technical innovations into compelling value propositions for quantum computing companies, national laboratories and HPC centres.  You will help us craft the value proposition and marketing plan for each of our partners.

What you will do 

  • Oversee Deltaflow’s product marketing strategy, positioning, messaging architecture and customer value proposition(s)
  • Segment the Deltaflow value proposition for different audiences, particularly quantum hardware companies, national labs and HPC Centres. They may require different capability bundles
  • Develop product briefs, presentations, website content, and sales collateral
  • Create effective collateral and campaigns including product website, video explainers, webinars and demos
  • Conduct market and competitor research analysis and reporting
  • Oversee our partner marketing programme for Deltaflow, covering both customers and technology partners. This will include joint demos, case studies, talks, usage data and testimonials
  • Manage one partner marketing manager, initially
  • Stay abreast of important engineering, science and product developments in the industry, particularly as it relates to QEC, real time decoding, control and simulation
  • Be a key member of a collaborative Marketing team of 6-8 people
  • Be a champion and voice of the customer within Riverlane

What we need 

  • A minimum 5+ years’ experience in deep tech product marketing
  • Proven success in articulating ‘deep tech’ with clear and compelling storytelling
  • Proven experience taking complex technical products from development through market adoption
  • Experience building positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies for emerging technology categories
  • Strong understanding of enterprise technology buyers and technical decision-making processes
  • A genuine curiosity about quantum computing
  • A collaborative, cross-functional team player, in line with our company values
  • Thrives in a fast-moving, rapidly evolving, self-empowering culture
  • Excellent written and spoken English

Even better if…

  • You have product marketing experience in quantum computing, semi-conductors, software or computing

What can you expect from us 

  • A comprehensive benefits package that includes an annual bonus plan, private medical insurance, life insurance, and a contributory pension scheme  
  • Equity, so that our team can share in the long-term success of Riverlane  
  • 28 days annual leave, plus bank holidays and enhanced family leave  
  • A diverse work environment that brings together experts in many fields (including software and hardware development, quantum information theory, physics and maths) and over 20 different nationalities  
  • A learning environment that encourages individual, team and company growth and development, including a regular programme of learning events and training and conference budgets 

How to apply

Please upload a CV and covering letter by clicking 'Apply Now'. Your covering letter should explain why you are applying for the job and what skills and experience you can bring to the role.

We review CVs as we receive them and interview as soon as we have applications that look like a good match. We do not use closing dates. So, please apply as soon as possible to avoid missing out on this role.

If you have any queries, please contact Everyone is welcome at Riverlane. We are an equal opportunities employer and encourage applications from eligible and suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender reassignment, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, or pregnancy and maternity/paternity.

Women and other underrepresented groups may be less likely to apply for a role unless they meet all or nearly all of the requirements.  If this applies to you, we still encourage you to apply - you may be a great fit, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. We’d love to hear from you.

You will lead the mk8s Core team, one of three mk8s teams. The Core team owns the API, the core of the service control plane, cluster autoscaling, platform integrations, and running k8s add-ons.

  • Maintain the technical vision for your area of responsibility.

  • Integrate cluster autoscaling approaches (e.g., Karpenter) to improve resource utilization and support seamless auto-upgrades.
  • Provide a Kubernetes-native way to use local disks to reduce disk I/O bottlenecks for AI training and inference, improving efficiency.
  • Deliver managed Layer 7 load balancers to reduce operational overhead for customers.

What you will bring to the table:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering or management experience
  • Excellent knowledge of Golang, or you are ready to quickly switch to this programming language
  • Expertise with

    • Owning multi-month technical projects.

It would be an added bonus if you had:

  • Flexibility and ownership

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Senior Software Engineer (Stream Processing)
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the event-processing pipelines and services that turn Nebius product usage into revenue.
You will work on systems that process a continuous stream of usage events, where correctness and failure recovery matter as much as throughput. The output is money: a silently dropped or double-counted event is a real financial error.
Usage of every Nebius product arrives as a stream of events. Our pipelines and services ingest, validate, enrich and price it in near real time, and deliver the results to invoicing, reporting and customer-facing account management.

In this role, you will:

  • Build stateful streaming pipelines that compute billed consumption in near real time.
  • Develop and operate Go services that ingest usage events, move data between our storage systems and deliver consumption data to users through usage APIs and billing data exports.
  • Guarantee correctness under failures: idempotency, exactly-once processing and reconciliation.
  • Operate transactional storage, persistent queues and change data capture under high throughput.
  • Build reusable streaming infrastructure rather than solving each use case independently.
  • Improve the reliability, scalability, latency and observability of the billing platform.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of your systems: design, implementation, reliability and deployment.

We expect you to have:

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals.
  • Professional experience building and operating backend, streaming or data-intensive systems.
  • The ability to reason about consistency and data correctness under failures.
  • Experience with databases, messaging systems or event-processing platforms.
  • The ability to investigate unfamiliar systems and solve problems without an obvious predefined solution.
  • The ability and willingness to learn the team's technology stack.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience with a stateful stream-processing framework such as Apache Flink or Kafka Streams.
  • Experience designing streaming pipelines.
  • Go development experience.
  • Experience operating services in Kubernetes.

Technology stack

  • Go, Python
  • Apache Flink

description:
Working Student – IT Asset & Stock Management (x/f/m) – Berlin

Join our mission, join Doctolib!

Doctolib is looking for you as a Working Student in IT Asset & Stock Management to support our IT team at our office in Berlin.
To give the best experience to Doctolibers and support Doctolib’s growth, you will help manage our IT stock and asset base, including laptops, smartphones and accessories. Reporting to the IT team, you will own the reliability of our hardware inventory and contribute to day-to-day on-site support in an international environment across Germany, France, Italy and the Netherlands.

What you’ll do

As a Working Student, you will support us in the following areas:
IT stock and asset management — approximately 70%
  • Manage the site’s IT stock, including receiving, checking, labelling and storing laptops, smartphones and accessories
  • Keep the inventory up to date in our asset management tool and ensure the accuracy of serial numbers, assignments and statuses
  • Follow the full equipment lifecycle, including assignment, return, loan, vendor repair, refurbishment and recycling
  • Run periodic physical inventories and consistency checks between physical stock and the asset management tool
  • Monitor stock levels, flag replenishment thresholds and contribute to supplier orders
  • Prepare devices, including mobile device management enrolment, standard configuration and accessory kits
  • Propose improvements to stock processes, documentation, automation and key performance indicators
On-site support — approximately 30%
  • Support onboarding and offboarding by preparing, handing over and recovering equipment for joiners and leavers
  • Run the Berlin IT Corner as a physical point of contact for Doctolibers
  • Manage meeting room hardware by testing, updating and replacing equipment
  • Handle level 1 requests and incidents, including basic diagnosis and application access, and escalate to level 2 when needed
  • Identify recurring requests and contribute to continuous improvement

Working with us, you will learn:

  • How to manage the full lifecycle of IT hardware and maintain reliable asset data
  • How on-site IT support contributes to a smooth employee experience
  • How to identify opportunities to improve operational processes through documentation, automation and performance indicators

Who you are

If you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

  • You are fluent in German and English
  • You are able to work on site in Berlin and handle equipment weighing up to 25 kg

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • You have had a first exposure to an IT service management or mobile device management tool

  • A Deutschlandticket sponsored by Doctolib, or reimbursement of your semester ticket
  • 28 vacation days per year (calculated pro rata according to your working schedule)
  • The opportunity to work from abroad for up to 10 days per year (eligible after 6 months)
  • Company health insurance with many additional benefits and subsidies (eligible after 6 months)
  • Regular breakfast in the office and subsidies for your lunch or grocery shopping
  • A subsidized sports program with our partner Urban Sports Club

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer (x/f/m)
description:
Your Impact

We are looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to join our SRE team dedicated to platform reliability within Platform Engineering.

Your mission will be to act as a technical leader driving Doctolib's reliability and scalability at a European scale, ensuring our platform remains reliable, debuggable, and resilient across infrastructure, observability, and cross-cutting reliability initiatives. You will play a pivotal role in a team driving reliability standards across 170+ applications, contributing directly to supporting 520,000 health professionals and 90 million patients in their daily healthcare journey.

This role sits at the intersection of infrastructure, developer experience, and product engineering. You'll act as a technical leader and strategic partner to SREs, software engineers, and product teams, guiding decisions, mentoring engineers, and driving cross-cutting initiatives that elevate our operational maturity.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Lead large-scale cross-cutting reliability initiatives across the platform, spanning infrastructure automation, observability, and incident management
  • Identify and drive improvements to incident detection, response, and postmortem analysis capabilities
  • Define and evolve SLOs, error budgets, and alerting standards across multiple product teams
  • Take part in the on-call rotation, and actively contribute to improving our on-call experience by refining alerting, reducing noise, and ensuring actionable telemetry
  • Serve as a mentor and technical coach to senior engineers, helping elevate the craft of reliability engineering across the company
  • Influence strategic decisions by providing technical guidance to leadership and representing reliability engineering in architectural reviews and platform discussions
  • Partner with software engineering teams to embed reliability practices early in the development lifecycle

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have extensive experience (8+ years) in SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure roles within a large-scale, multi-team production environment
  • Have proven experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Have strong experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, Kubernetes is a must, its deployment and scaling strategies ecosystem
  • Have implemented and operated SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets in production
  • Have experience managing on-call rotations and leading incident response in high-stakes environments
  • Have a strong systems engineering background with fluency in at least one backend programming language (e.g., Go, Python, Ruby)
  • Have a proven ability to lead through influence: setting technical direction, driving consensus, and mentoring engineers across teams
  • Are comfortable balancing long-term architecture work with fast, iterative improvements
  • Have clear, concise communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to drive alignment in ambiguous environments
  • Partner with feature teams to accelerate their production readiness, providing hands-on guidance on reliability best practices, launch reviews, and operational standards before go-live
  • Are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have deep expertise in observability tooling and architecture (logging, tracing, metrics)
  • Have experience designing and operating high-scale telemetry pipelines and working with developers to improve instrumentation quality
  • Appreciate working in regulated environments, healthcare, fintech, or similar; at Doctolib, data privacy and compliance are part of every engineering decision
  • Care about reliability enablement, golden paths, runbooks, shared libraries

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.
  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.
  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib
  • 28 vacation days + 1 additional day for each full calendar year of employment (up to a maximum of 30 days)
  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy
  • Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz
  • Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period)
  • The Doctolib Parent Care program, which includes one month additional parental leave and much more
  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth
  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care
  • Subsidized sports membership through our partner Urban Sports Club
  • A flexible workplace policy offering both hybrid and office-based mode
  • Alongside healthy snacks and our regular breakfast buffet, we provide a subsidized meal benefit
  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support
  • Relocation support in case of international mobility
  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

  • Recruiter Interview
  • System Design Interview
  • Technical SRE Interview
  • Behavioral Interview
  • At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

  • Permanent position
  • Tech stack: Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS / GCP, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, ArgoCD
  • Full-time
  • Berlin, Germany
  • Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)
  • Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to join the Scheduling team in Berlin.

Your mission will be to give practitioners their day back:  reclaiming the admin time they spend creating and managing appointments, so care teams can focus on what matters. You will work in a feature team developing scheduling infrastructure and booking experiences, contributing directly to a platform that books billions of appointments a year for health professionals and patients across Europe.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Lead a team of 6 to 7 engineers of mixed seniority, owning delivery, quality and production health end to end — keeping engagement high and standards higher
  • Together with your product partner, define the mission and vision for your team and build a roadmap you can defend to stakeholders
  • Take part in architecture reviews and help shape the technical direction of the Scheduling stream, including the migration of core scheduling capabilities from the monolith into purpose-built services
  • Set and uphold the security, reliability, performance and scalability standards required to remain the most trusted e-health SaaS in Europe
  • Partner with Talent and People teams to recruit, develop and retain engineers through career conversations and feedback they can act on
  • Embed AI-assisted engineering into how your team works day to day, with a clear and honest view of where it helps and where it does not
  • Continuously improve how the team operates — planning, on-call, bug backlog, incident follow-up — so the team spends its energy on what moves the needle

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have at least 6 years of software engineering experience and 3 years of engineering management experience, including leading a team of 5+ engineers through delivery, hiring and growth
  • Are credible with senior backend engineers — distributed systems, data modelling, latency and throughput are conversations you can hold and challenge; you stay close enough to the code to review a pull request, without needing to be the one writing it
  • Have hands-on experience modernising a large legacy system, ideally extracting services from a monolith, and know how to keep a team delivering while the ground moves
  • Are an effective communicator who can translate company goals into team objectives, and who says the uncomfortable thing early rather than late
  • Think critically and objectively, with a solution-oriented approach that brings people with you

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have worked in a regulated industry such as healthcare or fintech, where privacy and data protection shape design decisions

description:
Join our mission, join Doctolib! 

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join the Patient team in Paris. 

The Patient domain sits at the heart of Doctolib's mission: ensuring everyone has better access to the care they need, receives better care from health professionals, and can actively prevent health problems to improve their wellbeing.

You’ll design the search and recommendation engines behind our health companion, helping 100M patients across Europe instantly navigate to the exact care they need while delivering trusted, curated insights at every step. The retrieval and recommendation architecture you own will directly shape how relevant, fast, and trustworthy that experience is for every one of them.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design and build the production search & recommendation architecture: full retrieval, ranking, reranking pipeline with standard and off-the-shelf components (vector search, semantic retrieval, LLM/managed rerankers).
  • Establish strong baselines first (prompts, RAG, model selection) before reaching for custom ML.
  • Build evaluation and observability into every stage, with offline and online evaluation.
  • Set up the data/event feedback loops that drive iteration and feed deeper ML later.
  • Improve search relevance and ranking on Patient facing products , raising result quality
  • Own production quality: latency reliability, monitoring, and maintainability.
  • Partner with ML Engineers and collaborate closely with PMs and SWEs to define, build, and ship AI-powered features that deliver measurable value to users and the business. 


Who you are

Before you read on:  if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You could be our next team mate if you have:

  1. Production deployment: ability to ship algorithms to production (ECS-based service on AWS)
  2. Strong analytical mindset: result-oriented,  patient-first approach
  3. Significant experience as a Software or/and AI engineer shipping search or recommendation systems to production. 
  4. Hands-on experience building end-to-end retrieval: ranking,  reranking pipelines and familiar with nDCG, MAP, Recall@k, MRR
  5. AI-engineering proficiency: turning foundation models and off-the-shelf components into production systems: embeddings & vector search, semantic retrieval, RAG, LLM-based or managed rerankers (e.g. Vertex AI). You can succeed without training a model from scratch
  6. Architecture-first approach: you build the system, baselines, evals, and feedback loops with standard tooling before reaching for custom ML, and know when to partner with ML Engineers to break a ceiling
  7. Evaluation & observability built into every stage (retrieval, ranker, reranker) — offline and online eval, A/B testing, position-bias handling, monitoring
  8. Production deployment — ability to ship reliable, low-latency services to production (hundreds-of-ms SLAs), with care for data quality and long-term maintainability

 

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Experience at a B2C marketplace (e-commerce, hospitality, travel)
  • Additional ML methodologies: pattern mining, recommendation systems, experimentation, or causal inference
  • Have experience with search engines or information retrieval concepts

For example, our DoctoBERT project introduces open-source medical language models trained for French clinical text, with applications in named entity recognition, classification, and retrieval.   • A coding interview

title: Senior Returns Manager, EU
description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Returns Manager to own end-to-end reverse logistics performance across our UK and EU operations. From forecasting incoming volume through grading, refunds, fraud prevention, and resale, you'll build a returns operation that's fast, accurate, and cost-efficient — while turning returned inventory back into recovered value. This is a hands-on role for someone who can dig into root causes, manage partners and carriers, and build the reporting to prove it's working.

What You'll Do

Returns Forecasting & Planning

  • Build and maintain returns volume forecasting models across UK and EU markets, factoring in seasonality, backlog, promotions, and category-level return patterns
  • Translate forecasts into staffing, processing capacity, and warehouse space plans for returns operations
  • Monitor returns rate trends and flag volume shifts to inventory, finance, and merchandising teams

 

Customer Refunds

  • Oversee timely, accurate refund processing in line with UK and EU consumer rights regulations
  • Audit warehouse/QRC staff on grading standards and quality checks
  • Partner with customer service and finance to resolve refund discrepancies and disputes
  • Track refund turnaround time against SLA and resolve bottlenecks in the refund workflow

 

Fraud Detection & Prevention

  • Build and refine fraud detection processes for returns abuse (wardrobing, serial returners, empty-box claims, item-not-as-described fraud)
  • Partner with risk and customer service teams to develop fraud rules/flags and investigate high-risk cases
  • Balance fraud prevention with customer experience, avoiding over-blocking of legitimate returns

 

Returns Root Cause & Logistics Feedback

  • Track and categorize return reasons, with particular focus on logistics-driven returns (damaged in transit, wrong item shipped, late or failed delivery, packaging failure)
  • Partner with warehouse, supply chain, and carrier teams to reduce logistics-driven returns through root cause analysis and corrective action
  • Present return reason trends to leadership to inform packaging, product, and logistics improvements

 

Returns Resale & Recommerce

  • Manage resale/recommerce channels for graded inventory (open-box, refurbished, clearance, secondary market and liquidation partners)
  • Maximize recovery value on returned inventory while minimizing time-to-resale
  • Build and manage relationships with resale/liquidation partners and evaluate new recommerce channels across UK and EU markets

 

Reverse Logistics & Carrier Management

  • Negotiate rates and service levels with carriers for return shipments across UK and EU markets
  • Manage carrier performance for return pickups, label generation, and inbound transit times
  • Evaluate and roll out returns-specific shipping options (paperless returns, drop-off points, pickup services) to reduce cost and improve the customer experience

 

SLA & Performance Management

  • Define and manage SLAs across the returns lifecycle — receipt to grading, grading to disposition, refund turnaround, and time-to-resale
  • Monitor 3PL and warehouse partner performance against returns SLAs; escalate and resolve issues as needed
  • Build reporting and dashboards to track returns KPIs and turn data into actionable recommendations for leadership

 

Cross-Functional & Compliance

  • Partner with customer service, supply chain, finance, and merchandising to align returns operations with broader business goals
  • Ensure returns operations comply with UK and EU consumer protection, distance selling, and VAT/duty rules (including treatment of re-imported goods and refund-related VAT adjustments)
  • Stay current on evolving returns-related regulation across UK and EU markets

What You'll Bring

Required

  • 5–8+ years managing returns or reverse logistics operations in a high-volume ecommerce or retail environment, ideally across UK and EU markets
  • Experience building returns forecasting and capacity planning models
  • Solid understanding of UK and EU consumer rights, refund, and distance-selling regulations
  • Experience designing or managing returns fraud detection and prevention programs
  • Track record reducing logistics-driven returns through root cause analysis and cross-functional fixes
  • Experience managing return resale, refurbishment, or liquidation channels
  • Carrier negotiation experience for reverse logistics/return shipping
  • Strong SLA and KPI management skills, with reporting experience (Excel, SQL, or BI tools)
  • Hands-on experience with WMS/OMS returns modules
  • Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills

 

Preferred

  • Experience in DTC, fashion/apparel, or other high-return-rate ecommerce categories
  • Familiarity with recommerce or liquidation platforms and partners
  • Experience operating across multiple EU countries and languages
  • Background in fraud/risk analytics
  • Experience managing reverse logistics SLAs with UK/EU carriers (e.g., Royal Mail, Evri, DPD, DHL, GLS)



WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

THE ROLE

Senior Creative Strategist 

The Sr. Creative Strategist for UK/EU is a performance-minded, market-savvy leader who bridges global creative output with the nuances of European consumer behaviour. This person excels at identifying what's working in the US market and translating it for UK and German/French audiences; while also building the infrastructure to test, learn and scale independently. This person is energized by solving complex business problems, making high-judgment decisions in ambiguous environments, and turning insights into scalable, revenue-driving creative strategy.

Success in this role looks like:

  • Consistently identifying high-performing US creative and adapting it to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth in UK & DE/FR markets
  • Owning the experimentation framework that enables the EU/UK team to move fast, document learnings, and scale winners while maintaining strong alignment with brand identity
  • Serving as the primary creative liaison between UK & DE/FR market needs and the US creative and production teams
  • Improving win rates and spend efficiency through a rigorous, data-backed testing cadence
  • Acting as a strategic partner to the Director of Paid Social UK & DE/FR and cross-functional brand, design, and marketing teams
  • Leveraging data to inform strategic direction
  • This role is critical to establishing Paid Social as a core growth engine in the UK, Germany and France.

This role will be onsite 4-days a week based in London, Madrid, or Berlin. 

Responsibilities

Creative Adaptation & Briefing

  • Audit US creative performance regularly to identify high-potential concepts for UK & DE/FR adaptation
  • Brief the US creative team on market-specific adaptation needs; adjusting copy, tone, cultural references, pricing, and product focus for UK & DE/FR audiences
  • Commission net-new creative concepts where US assets are insufficient or market-specific angles are required
  • Write clear, detailed high converting ad briefs for video, static, UGC, and other ad formats with UK & DE/FR market context embedded
  • Ensure all adapted and net-new creative aligns with brand identity while resonating locally
  • Provide strategic feedback to designers and execute on feedback from leadership

Experimentation & Performance

  • Build and own a structured experimentation framework for UK & DE/FR paid social; covering hypothesis formation, test design, documentation, and results reporting
  • Prioritise and manage a live test pipeline across Meta (and other channels) to continuously improve creative performance
  • Analyse performance data in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Looker; translate findings into clear strategic recommendations
  • Conduct consumer, competitor, and trend research specific to UK & DE/FR markets to inform creative direction
  • Identify winning patterns and codify them into repeatable brief templates and creative playbooks

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the EU/UK creative point of contact for the US production and strategy teams
  • Partner with the Director of Paid Social EU/UK on channel strategy, creative priorities, and growth planning
  • Collaborate with Brand, Design, and broader Marketing teams to align creative output across channels including affiliate, CRM, and PR

Qualifications

Required: 

  • Bachelor’s degree required

We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. raw.title: Head of Finance (f/m/d)
raw.description:
Description

We are building a finance function that enables our next phase of growth. As Head of Finance, you will own finance end-to-end, laying the financial foundation for a scaling deep-tech hardware company – from reporting, controlling, treasury, and public funding to the financial infrastructure supporting global equipment deliveries.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will work closely with the leadership team, board, investors, and external partners to shape the company's financial strategy and operational excellence. This is a hands-on build role with a clear growth trajectory. Within your first 12–18 months, you will establish scalable financial processes, strengthen governance and controls, build a high-performing finance function, and create the foundation for international growth and future financing rounds. For the right person, the role offers a clear path toward CFO as the company scales.

 

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

 

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Own the finance function end-to-end, including accounting, controlling, treasury, tax, compliance, and financial operations

  • Lead monthly and annual financial reporting under HGB, while building IFRS readiness to support future financing, audits, and international growth

  • Drive budgeting, forecasting, cash flow planning, and business partnering across R&D, manufacturing, commercial, and corporate functions

  • Build the financial backbone for global capital equipment deliveries, including multi-currency operations, FX management, hedging, export considerations, and international invoicing

  • Manage large-scale European Chips Act funding and other public funding programs, including financial reporting, cost statements, audits, and compliance with funding authorities

  • Lead treasury and liquidity management, including venture debt, financing activities, and cash planning across commercial and public funding cycles

  • Support fundraising activities, board reporting, investor relations, and strategic financial planning alongside the CEO

  • Design scalable financial processes for order management, revenue recognition, procurement, and internal controls appropriate for a global capital equipment business

  • Lead the evolution of our ERP landscape and financial systems, establishing robust reporting, automation, and efficient finance operations

  • Build, develop, and lead the finance team as the organization grows, fostering strong business partnering across the company

  • Manage relationships with auditors, tax advisors, banks, funding agencies, and other external stakeholders

  • Lead and develop the Finance team, building capability, defining clear ownership, and growing the function as the company scales

 

What is expected of you

  • Proven finance leadership experience in a deep-tech, hardware, semiconductor, industrial technology, or other capital-intensive environment

  • Strong experience building and scaling finance functions in a high-growth company, combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution

  • Experience managing European public funding programs (European Chips Act or comparable initiatives), including financial reporting, audits, and compliance

  • Strong knowledge of HGB and practical IFRS experience, ideally supporting fundraising, audits, or international expansion

  • Experience supporting capital equipment or project-based businesses with long sales cycles, milestone billing, revenue recognition, and complex customer contracts

  • Strong treasury experience, including liquidity planning, multi-currency operations, FX management, and financing activities such as venture debt

  • Experience partnering with executive leadership, boards, investors, and external stakeholders to support strategic decision-making

  • Experience implementing or scaling ERP systems and financial processes in a growing organization (Odoo is a plus)

  • A collaborative leadership style with the ability to build teams, develop talent, and establish scalable financial processes

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition and capability to grow into a CFO role as the company scales

  • Fluent English; German is an advantage

 

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

 

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

Description

We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order.

 
 

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

 

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements.

  • Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months.

  • Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team.

  • Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements.

  • For each requirement, define acceptance criteria from the customer's point of view so it is clear and testable when the need is met, and link them to customer evaluation and qualification plans.

  • Align with the Product Development department on scope and timing, and hand solution-neutral requirements into engineering: state the need and the why, and leave the how to the disciplines.

  • Support go-to-market: give input on positioning, pricing, launch readiness, and documentation scope together with the applications, operations, and product development teams.

 

What is expected of you

  • Several years in product management for complex hardware or capital equipment, ideally in semiconductor, metrology, or a comparable deep-tech environment.

  • A track record of writing clear product requirements that engineering can actually build from.

  • The ability to talk to both customers and engineers and to translate between them.

  • Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with the people designing the product, across mechanics, optics, electronics/RF, and software.

  • Structured prioritization: you make trade-offs explicit and back them with reasoning.

  • We hire for demonstrated skill rather than a specific degree; a technical or scientific background is typical. The working language is English.

Additional experience we value:

  • Semiconductor industry knowledge (fabs, IDMs, OSATs, inspection, metrology, or failure analysis).

  • Familiarity with SEMI standards and fab tool integration (for example, S2/S8, E10, SECS/GEM).

  • Experience selecting or setting up a requirements management tool (for example, Jama, Polarion, or CodeBeamer).

  • A working understanding of quantum sensing, optics, or precision instrumentation.

 

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

 

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

We are looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer to join our Sales Engineering team. You will partner with Account Executives to qualify, progress, and close revenue opportunities with Fortune 500 prospects — guiding them through demos, architecture discussions, and proofs-of-concept that prove Coder’s value for both human developers and the AI coding agents working alongside them.

This is not a scripted-demo-only role. You are equally comfortable running a deep technical proof-of-concept and stepping back to translate a technical win into a business case an economic buyer will act on. You are energized by ambiguity, motivated by winning deals the right way, and capable of bringing the voice of the prospect back into how Coder builds and sells.

  • Run proofs-of-concept that prove Coder’s value including for agentic and LLM-powered development workflows and accelerate deals

  • Evolve into a subject-matter expert on Cloud Development Environments, agentic AI development, and their business impact

title: Technisch Support Engineer
description: Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan. Steeds meer woningen worden verwarmd met onze warmtepompen. En dat betekent dat we ook steeds meer installaties moeten monitoren, klanten ondersteunen en technische problemen oplossen. Daarom zoeken we een Technical Support Engineer die ons support team komt versterken. Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische vragen, onderzoekt storingen en zorgt dat onze warmtepompen optimaal blijven functioneren. Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan het probleem van vandaag. Waarom ontstaat een storing? Hoe kunnen we die in de toekomst voorkomen? En hoe kunnen we onze support slimmer organiseren? Je lost dus niet alleen problemen op, maar helpt ons ook om onze producten en service steeds beter te maken. Wat ga je doen? Als Technical Support Engineer ben je een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor technische vragen over onze warmtepompen. Je combineert technisch inzicht met klantcontact en werkt nauw samen met onze service-, product- en engineeringteams. Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische problemen Je analyseert storingen en zoekt uit wat er aan de hand is, bijvoorbeeld door systeemdata en instellingen te onderzoeken. Je ondersteunt klanten telefonisch en per mail bij technische vragen en problemen. Je helpt installateurs en servicemonteurs bij het oplossen van technische problemen. Je past waar nodig instellingen van warmtepompen aan om hun prestaties te optimaliseren. Je schakelt servicemonteurs in wanneer een probleem niet op afstand kan worden opgelost en zorgt voor een goede overdracht. Je helpt onze support steeds slimmer en beter te maken Je herkent terugkerende problemen en denkt mee over structurele oplossingen. Je maakt en verbetert technische documentatie, handleidingen en werkinstructies. Je deelt inzichten uit de praktijk met onze product- en engineeringteams, zodat we onze warmtepompen verder kunnen verbeteren. Je denkt mee over hoe we onze processen en systemen kunnen verbeteren en automatiseren. Je komt terecht in een groeiend team waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Dat betekent dat je veel kunt leren, verantwoordelijkheid krijgt en zelf invloed hebt op hoe we werken. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken iemand die technisch nieuwsgierig is, graag problemen oplost en energie krijgt van het helpen van anderen. Je hoeft nog geen expert in warmtepompen te zijn. We leren je graag hoe onze systemen werken. Wat we belangrijk vinden: Je hebt een technische hbo-opleiding afgerond, bijvoorbeeld in werktuigbouwkunde, elektrotechniek of een vergelijkbare richting. Je hebt technisch en analytisch inzicht en vindt het leuk om uit te zoeken hoe systemen werken. Je communiceert duidelijk en prettig, ook met mensen die minder technische kennis hebben. Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands. Je bent zelfstandig, leergierig en neemt initiatief wanneer je ziet dat iets beter kan. Je vindt het leuk om zowel met techniek als met mensen bezig te zijn. Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar. Mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen vereiste: Ervaring met technische support, troubleshooting of klantcontact. Kennis van warmtepompen, installatietechniek of andere technische systemen. Ervaring met Python, data-analyse of het automatiseren van processen. Wat bieden wij jou? Een salaris van €3.000 tot €4.000 bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van je ervaring. 27 vakantiedagen. Een pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding. De mogelijkheid om mee te delen in het succes van DeWarmte via onze Stock Appreciation Rights (SAR). Veel ruimte om te leren, jezelf te ontwikkelen en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Een informele werkomgeving met korte lijnen en collega's die graag samenwerken. De mogelijkheid om deels vanuit huis te werken, naast onze gezamenlijke kantoordagen. En natuurlijk de kans om bij te dragen aan de energietransitie met producten die we zelf ontwikkelen en verbeteren. Zin om mee te bouwen? Bij DeWarmte houden we van mensen die initiatief nemen, nieuwsgierig zijn en samen dingen beter willen maken. Je hoeft niet alles al te kunnen. Als je graag leert, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van techniek en het helpen van mensen, maken we graag kennis met je. Compensation: €3K – €4K per month • €3K – €4K per month Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Financial Director
description: Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan. We groeien hard. Met een flinke groeispurt in het aantal aanvragen, een groeiende operatie in Nederland en onze eerste stappen in Duitsland breekt een nieuwe fase aan. Daarom zoeken we een Financial Director die onderdeel wordt van ons Management Team en de volledige verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor Finance. Je wordt ons vierde MT-lid en werkt nauw samen met onze CEO, COO en People Director aan de verdere groei van DeWarmte. Je begint niet vanaf nul. Onze founders hebben een sterke financiële basis neergezet, met een geïntegreerd financieel model dat zich al tijdens meerdere financieringsrondes en due diligence-trajecten heeft bewezen. Nu zoeken we iemand die daarop voortbouwt en Finance naar een volgend niveau brengt. En daar krijg je alle ruimte voor. Je ontwikkelt je eigen visie op de financiële organisatie, stelt een financiële roadmap op en bouwt een schaalbaar team. Je vertaalt cijfers naar betere beslissingen, daagt bestaande aannames uit en helpt ons de juiste keuzes te maken terwijl we groeien. We zoeken iemand die strategisch denkt, maar ook graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen steekt. Die het grotere plaatje ziet, maar net zo makkelijk de diepte ingaat om een financieel vraagstuk op te lossen. Wat ga je doen? Als Financial Director ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor Finance én denk je als MT-lid mee over de koers van DeWarmte. Je bouwt voort op een sterke financiële basis en zorgt dat onze financiële organisatie klaar is voor de volgende groeifase. Financiële strategie en business performance Je ontwikkelt de financiële strategie en roadmap en vertaalt onze groeiambities naar concrete plannen en doelstellingen. If that sounds like your kind of place, we’d like to meet you. Über die Rolle Du wirst die erste Person bei LIFTED, die sich voll um Finance kümmert. Bisher macht das Carl, Co-Founder und Geschäftsführer, neben allem anderen. Ab jetzt baust du den Bereich mit ihm auf. Heute haben wir sechs Studios, bis Ende 2027 werden es rund 20, in mehreren Städten. Jede Eröffnung bringt einen Business Case, ein Budget, eine Finanzierung und neue Zahlen im Monatsabschluss. Weil du direkt mit Carl arbeitest, siehst du all das aus erster Hand. Du startest im Tagesgeschäft: Zahlungsverkehr, Monatsabschluss, Liquidität, Planung. Sobald das sauber läuft, übernimmst du mehr, bis hin zu FP&A, Business Cases für neue Studios und Finanzierung. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Steuerbüro, unserem Admin-Team, dem Expansion-Team und den City Managern zusammen. Aufgaben Finance Operations Du verantwortest den Zahlungsverkehr inklusive Gehaltslauf, Leasing und Kautionen. Die Vorkontierung macht unser Admin-Team nach klaren Regeln. Du kennst die Logik dahinter, prüfst Stichproben, klärst neue Fälle und entwickelst die Regeln in Moss weiter. Monatsabschluss & Reporting Du bereitest den Monatsabschluss mit unserem Steuerbüro vor, grenzt Umsätze von Partnern wie Urban Sports Club und Trainerkosten ab und prüfst die BWA. Daraus erstellst du in Helu ein monatliches Reporting pro Studio und gleichst Plan und Ist ab. Planung & Liquidität Du pflegst unsere Planung, die nach BWA-Konten und Kostenstellen aufgebaut ist, und hältst sie bei neuen Studios und Änderungen aktuell. Du planst die Liquidität rollierend und bereitest die Unterlagen für Banken und Partner vor. HR-Administration Vorerst kümmerst du dich auch um Personalstammdaten, Arbeitsverträge und die Vorbereitung der Payroll. Was du Schritt für Schritt übernimmst Mit wachsender Erfahrung übernimmst du FP&A: Budget, Forecast und Szenarien, etwa wenn sich bei einem neuen Studio Miete oder Eröffnungstermin ändern. Du rechnest Business Cases für neue Standorte, bevor wir unterschreiben. Du bereitest Finanzierungsgespräche vor und führst sie zunehmend mit. Qualifikation Ausbildung: Abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, VWL, Finance oder einem ähnlichen Fach. Berufserfahrung: 2–4 Jahre in Finance, idealerweise in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Unternehmen. Antrieb: Du willst schneller lernen, als es dein bisheriger Job zulässt, und übernimmst Verantwortung, bevor dich jemand darum bittet. Setup: Du kennst das Zusammenspiel aus vorbereitender Buchhaltung, externem Steuerbüro und DATEV und hast schon mit SKR03 oder SKR04 gearbeitet. Tools: Du arbeitest sicher in Excel. Erfahrung mit Moss, Helu oder ähnlichen Tools ist ein Plus. Hands-on: Du packst operative Themen selbst an und baust Abläufe so, dass sie ohne dich laufen. Business-Interesse: Du willst verstehen, warum eine Zahl so ist, wie sie ist. Sprachen: Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch (C2) und sicher Englisch. Standort: Du lebst in Berlin (oder bist bereit umzuziehen). Benefits Direkt mit den Foundern: Du reportest direkt an Carl und bist seine rechte Hand bei allen Finance-Themen, mit voller Transparenz über die Zahlen. Du bekommst so viel Verantwortung, wie du übernehmen kannst, und wie weit das geht, liegt an dir. Steile Lernkurve: Du lernst alle Bereiche von Finance kennen, vom Zahlungsverkehr über FP&A bis zur Finanzierung. Coaching: Du lernst von einem Gründerteam, das schon einmal ein Fitnessunternehmen aufgebaut hat, und direkt von Carl. Wir setzen auf dich, fordern dich und helfen dir, schnell besser zu werden. Solides Fundament: Ein profitables Geschäft, das schnell wächst. Berlin HQ: Unser Büro im Prenzlauer Berg (Senefelder Platz). Becoming Stronger: Eine kostenlose, unbegrenzte Mitgliedschaft für alle LIFTED Studios. Team Spirit: Regelmäßige Teamevents wie Padel, BBQs und Trainer-Partys. Wir schätzen deine Zeit. Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen CV und eine kurze Notiz (3–5 Sätze) zu dem, worauf du in deiner bisherigen Finance-Arbeit am meisten stolz bist. Du hast die ersten Jahre in Finance hinter dir und Lust, jetzt richtig was zu reißen? Dann bewirb dich. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Du arbeitest immer in einem Projektteam mit anderen Engineers und Consultants. Gemeinsam klärt ihr mit Fachbereich und IT-Leitung unserer Kund:innen, was sie brauchen. Die Architektur verantwortest du, und das System bauen und betreiben wir zusammen.

So läuft ein Projekt bei uns

Ein typisches Projekt hat drei Phasen, und du begleitest alle als technisch verantwortliche Person im Projektteam.

  1. Discovery Sprint mit dem Fachbereich: Wir legen fest, welches Problem wir lösen und woran wir den Erfolg messen.

  2. Pilotphase mit klaren Go/No-Go-Kriterien: Ihr baut eine erste Version, die Nutzer:innen im Fachbereich testen.

  3. Ausbau und Betrieb: Trägt der Pilot, bringt ihr das System in den Alltag und haltet es mit Monitoring stabil.

Deine Aufgaben

Bei aktuellen Projekten dreht es sich viel um das Training von eigenen VLMs und um das, was jedes Unternehmen umtreibt: den Einsatz von Agentic AI im gesamten Unternehmenskosmos.

  • Du konzipierst LLM-Anwendungen mit RAG, strukturierter Extraktion und Agentic Workflows und entscheidest die Architektur.

  • Backend-Services und APIs entwickelst du in Python, meist mit FastAPI.

  • Auf Azure, meist mit Azure OpenAI und AI Foundry, bringst du die Systeme in Betrieb und betreust sie dort.

  • Mit Tests, Evaluation und Monitoring sicherst du die Qualität von Anfang an.

  • Gemeinsam mit unseren Consultants klärst du Anforderungen mit Fachbereich und IT-Leitung der Kund:innen.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens eine LLM-Anwendung oder ein ML-Modell selbst in Betrieb gebracht, die Menschen im Arbeitsalltag nutzen.

  • Python beherrschst du sicher, inklusive Tests und Deployment.

  • Erfahrung mit einer Cloud-Plattform bringst du mit, am liebsten Azure, alternativ AWS oder GCP.

  • Deine technischen Entscheidungen kannst du begründen, auch gegenüber Kund:innen.

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine Ausbildung in Informatik, Mathematik, Data Science oder einem verwandten Feld, alternativ vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, weil der Kundenkontakt auf Deutsch läuft.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Den Aufbau eines Unternehmens begleiten und eine neue Generation von Beratung und Engineering prägen

Ehrlich vorab

Wir sind ein kleines Team ohne eigenes Plattform-Team, und viele technische Entscheidungen triffst du selbst. Wer lieber in einem großen Team an einem eigenen Produkt arbeitet, ist woanders vermutlich glücklicher.

Bewirb dich bei uns

Das ist der Ablauf unseres Bewerbungsverfahrens:

  3. Treffen in Köln mit gemeinsamem Essen, Einblick in laufende Projekte und fachlichem Sparring im Team.

Nach jedem Schritt hörst du innerhalb von einem Werktag von uns. Von der Bewerbung bis zum Angebot planen wir drei Wochen.

At NICE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

Why this role matters now

This role sits at the centre of our AI-led delivery transformation. We are rebuilding our digital evidence platform as AI-Native, with AI tooling acting as a daily partner from design through verification. The right architect is not someone with a long list of AI credentials - AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. The right architect is someone who already uses AI in their daily work, has formed clear judgement about where it belongs and where it does not, and is curious enough to learn the next tool when their current one is superseded.

So, what’s the role all about?

We are looking for a talented Architect and Software Developer to join our team. You must:

  • Be able to communicate effectively, including via email, instant message, phone, and video conferencing tools.
  • Be fierce in your pursuit of product quality.
  • Be an excellent problem solver with an active interest in the latest design and development tools and technologies.
  • Be knowledgeable and enthusiastic about process.
  • Be practically fluent with AI tooling - using Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent in your daily work, not just experimentally. We will discuss specific examples at interview.
  • Be able to recognize opportunities for optimization and enhancement of process, product architecture and delivery based on the evolutions in AI.
  • Have clear judgement about where AI belongs in a public-safety platform, and where it does not.

How will you make an impact?

You will be responsible for:

  • Owning the architecture, and carrying out design, AI-led implementation and validation in Cloud-based, multi-threaded, multi-server environments -working in our AI-led delivery method where code, tests and decisions are AI-drafted, with you setting intent, orchestrating implementation, and validating outputs.
  • Leading technical decisions on architectural direction using a collaborative, team-based approach.
  • Ensuring the architecture takes into account the concerns of security, scalability, compatibility, maintainability — and the responsible, evidenced use of AI in both build-time and run-time.
  • Performing testing of your work, fixing defects, and helping to resolve customer support cases.
  • Ensuring that the team adheres to the architectural direction and standards.
  • Mentoring and coaching team members in architecture practices, AI-led delivery techniques, and the discipline of validating AI outputs.
  • Liaising with Product Management during planning sessions.

Have you got what it takes?

  • Solid experience developing applications in C# using Visual Studio/Visual Studio Code.
  • Proven track record of breaking down complex market requirements into secure, scalable and resilient system designs.
  • Experience with multi-tenant cloud solutions.
  • Experience working in collaborative multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience creating maintainable code and using source control solutions such as DevOps, GIT or similar.
  • Experience of unit testing, code reviews, and other product quality disciplines.
  • Solid understanding of the principles of network security, authentication, and authorization.
  • Experience of working with databases using Entity Framework or similar.
  • Good knowledge of SOLID principles.
  • Experience creating RESTful APIs and ensuring API extensibility.
  • Recent practical experience using AI tooling (Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent) in your daily work, not just experimentation. Comfortable describing what worked, what did not, and what you decided.
  • Output discipline: you remain accountable for the architecture you are responsible for, whatever helped you produce it.
  • Comfort with probabilistic systems, and clear judgement about when to use AI in a high-trust domain.
  • Learning velocity: able to ramp on a new AI tool or technique in days, not months.

You will have an advantage if you also have:

  • Security best practice (OWASP top ten)
  • Azure SQL Server
  • DevOps, Pipelines, TeamCity, GitHub
  • Windows services
  • Experience using AI tooling specifically in the architect role - for design review, ADR drafting, threat modelling, contract design, or similar.
  • Familiarity with AI-Native software patterns (agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, prompt-and-response evaluation, evidence packets).

What we do not require

We do not require you to be an AI expert. AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. We require curiosity, recent practical use, output discipline, and the judgement to ship under accountability.

About the interview process

The final stage includes a working session using our AI tooling. The aim is to see how you think - how you set intent, validate outputs, and make decisions - not to test memorised knowledge.

Shape the future of global regulatory reporting transformation
