raw.jobDescription:
Chief Architect

Remote - US

Legion Technologies is building the AI-powered operating system for the hourly workforce. We are hiring a Chief Architect to serve as Legion’s most senior hands-on technical leader and to shape the technical foundation that will power the next decade of product innovation.

This is not a strategy-only or advisory role. The Chief Architect must live close to the code, go deep with engineering teams, challenge assumptions, write and review technical designs, make high-consequence architecture decisions, and help turn bold product ambitions into scalable, reliable production systems.

This person will own architecture and technical decision-making for the most complex parts of Legion’s Workforce Management platform, including AI, optimization, forecasting, scheduling, distributed systems, data platforms, real-time decisioning, enterprise scalability, security, compliance, and developer productivity.

The ideal candidate has built and scaled mission-critical software used by large enterprise customers, has deep technical credibility with senior engineers, and can operate fluidly between code-level decisions and long-term platform strategy. They are pragmatic, decisive, opinionated, and comfortable making hard tradeoffs when simplicity, scalability, reliability, or customer trust require it.

This role reports to the Head of Product, Engineering, and Support. This is an open role currently being filled on an interim basis by the CEO.

Responsibilities and Duties

Hands-On Architecture and Technical Decision-Making

Serve as Legion’s senior-most hands-on technical authority for complex architecture, system design, and platform evolution.

  • Personally dive into code, design documents, production incidents, performance bottlenecks, and implementation tradeoffs to diagnose root causes and guide technical direction.
  • Lead the hardest technical decisions across AI systems, optimization engines, distributed systems, data architecture, reliability, scalability, security, and platform modernization.
  • Write prototypes, reference implementations, architecture decision records, technical specifications, and design patterns where needed to unblock teams and establish clear direction.
  • Make high-consequence technical decisions with incomplete information, balancing correctness, simplicity, speed, scalability, reliability, cost, and long-term maintainability.
  • Challenge architectural drift, unnecessary complexity, weak abstractions, and short-term decisions that create long-term platform risk.
  • Partner directly with Staff, Principal, and senior engineering leaders in design reviews, code-level discussions, and implementation planning.

Platform Architecture and Technical Vision

  • Define and own the long-term architecture for Legion’s AI-driven Workforce Management platform across application services, data infrastructure, ML systems, optimization engines, APIs, integration architecture, developer platforms, and enterprise-scale operations.
  • Establish engineering-wide standards for system design, scalability, performance, reliability, extensibility, observability, security, and maintainability.
  • Serve as the final architectural authority for major platform initiatives and technical decisions with long-term consequences.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce complexity, improve system efficiency, accelerate engineering velocity, and unlock new product capabilities.
  • Proactively surface technical debt, architectural risk, and platform constraints before they compound into customer, product, or engineering velocity issues.
  • Create pragmatic migration paths from current-state architecture to target-state architecture while maintaining uptime, customer trust, backward compatibility, and delivery speed.
  • Ensure Legion’s architecture supports enterprise configurability and extensibility without allowing uncontrolled customization or product fragmentation.

AI, Optimization, and Decision Systems

  • Architect AI-native product capabilities across forecasting, scheduling, labor optimization, recommendations, copilots or agents, anomaly detection, decision automation, and other intelligent workforce management use cases.
  • Define the architecture for production AI systems, including data pipelines, feature platforms, model training, model serving, retrieval, evaluation, monitoring, feedback loops, and continuous improvement.
  • Make clear build-versus-buy decisions across LLMs, classical ML, optimization solvers, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, and internal AI platforms.
  • Partner closely with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to turn mathematically complex labor optimization problems into reliable, scalable, explainable production systems.
  • Establish standards for AI system quality, including accuracy, latency, cost, explainability, drift detection, reliability, customer-specific behavior, and production observability.
  • Ensure Legion’s AI capabilities remain differentiated, defensible, enterprise-ready, and deeply integrated into operational workflows rather than bolted on as superficial features.

Distributed Systems, Data, and Enterprise Scale

  • Drive architecture for large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS systems serving complex enterprise customers with high availability, performance, security, and compliance expectations.
  • Lead technical decisions involving microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture, distributed data processing, real-time systems, data governance, and large-scale analytics.
  • Improve the architecture for observability, incident analysis, performance engineering, capacity planning, reliability, and operational excellence.
  • Use production data, incidents, escalations, and customer operational patterns as inputs into architecture and platform improvement.
  • Ensure architectural decisions support global scale, data residency, enterprise integrations, configurability, extensibility, and long-term platform leverage.

Product, Business, and Customer Impact

  • Connect technical decisions directly to customer value, product velocity, implementation speed, scalability, reliability, and long-term platform advantage.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate ambitious product goals into executable architecture and technical roadmaps.
  • Understand enterprise customer complexity and design systems that support real-world operational variability without creating unsustainable technical debt.
  • Support strategic customer, partner, and vendor architecture discussions where deep technical credibility is required.
  • Help evaluate technical implications of major product, partner, platform, and commercial decisions.

Engineering Culture and Technical Talent

  • Mentor and elevate Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, architects, and senior engineering leaders across the organization.
  • Raise the bar for technical judgment, system design, architecture reviews, documentation, code quality, operational discipline, and engineering craftsmanship.
  • Help assess, attract, and develop senior technical talent, including Staff, Principal, and architect-level engineers.
  • Build a culture of disciplined technical thinking, direct debate, clear decision-making, and pragmatic execution.
  • Ensure architectural decisions are documented clearly, understood broadly, and translated into executable engineering plans.

Security, Compliance, and Enterprise Readiness

  • Own the architectural approach to enterprise security, data governance, privacy, compliance, auditability, and resilience.
  • Ensure architecture supports SOC 2, ISO 27001, data residency, access control, tenant isolation, regulatory requirements, and other needs of large global enterprise customers.
  • Partner with Security, Infrastructure, Product, and Engineering teams to make security and compliance foundational architectural properties rather than after-the-fact controls.

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 15% travel for leadership collaboration, engineering offsites, strategic customer engagements, and other business-critical meetings.

Required Skills and Qualifications

Experience Level

15+ years of experience building and scaling large-scale software systems.Prior experience as a Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, Principal Architect, very senior Principal Engineer, or equivalent senior technical leadership role.

  • Demonstrated success designing and scaling mission-critical, multi-tenant SaaS platforms for enterprise customers.
  • Deep hands-on experience with large-scale distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, data platforms, APIs, event-driven systems, platform engineering, and high-availability production environments.
  • Proven ability to operate as a hands-on technical leader who can credibly engage in code-level and design-level discussions with senior engineers.
  • Experience making major architecture decisions for systems with high scale, high reliability requirements, complex domain logic, and long product lifecycles.
  • Experience modernizing large production systems incrementally while maintaining uptime, backward compatibility, customer trust, and engineering velocity.
  • Experience building or supporting AI, ML, optimization, decisioning, forecasting, or data-intensive products in production.
  • Strong understanding of observability, incident response, performance engineering, reliability architecture, capacity planning, and operational excellence.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineering teams, executives, customers, and cross-functional partners.

Technical Depth

  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, system design, cloud architecture, service-oriented or microservices architectures, APIs, event-driven systems, and large-scale data processing.
  • Strong experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Strong experience with modern engineering practices, including architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, testing strategy, deployment architecture, observability, and production operations.
  • Experience with languages such as Java, Kotlin, Go, Python, Scala, or similar modern backend languages.
  • Ability to reason deeply about tradeoffs involving performance, latency, throughput, cost, reliability, developer productivity, extensibility, and maintainability.

Leadership and Judgment

  • Strong architectural judgment: knows when to simplify, when to re-platform, when to tolerate debt, and when to force a hard technical reset.
  • Demonstrated ability to make bold technical decisions with incomplete information and drive alignment across senior technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to influence without relying on hierarchy, while still being willing to make clear decisions when consensus is insufficient.
  • Strong product and business judgment; able to connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes, implementation speed, product differentiation, and company strategy.
  • Pragmatic builder mindset: balances long-term architecture with startup speed, customer urgency, and execution realities.

Preferred Qualifications and Attributes

  • Experience building platforms used by millions of users or supporting very large-scale enterprise operations.
  • Experience at companies known for large-scale distributed systems, AI, cloud infrastructure, enterprise SaaS, workforce management, supply chain, fintech, commerce, logistics, or other complex operational domains.
  • Familiarity with optimization engines, scheduling algorithms, forecasting systems, constraint solvers, real-time decision systems, or mathematically complex production systems.
  • Experience architecting AI-native product capabilities, including LLM-enabled workflows, AI agents or copilots, model evaluation, retrieval systems, feedback loops, and production monitoring.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms, platform infrastructure, data platforms, ML pipelines, or large-scale analytics systems.
  • Experience designing highly configurable enterprise platforms without creating unbounded customization or implementation complexity.
  • Experience participating in strategic customer architecture reviews or technical due diligence with large enterprise customers.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; PhD a plus but not required.

Candidate Profile

The strongest candidate will be a deeply technical, hands-on architect who still has the range to shape company-level technical direction. They are not a generic enterprise architect, process owner, or strategy-only leader. They are a builder and technical decision-maker who can personally engage with Legion’s hardest problems and earn the respect of the strongest engineers in the company.

They should be comfortable moving between:

  • Code and architecture.
  • Product ambition and technical feasibility.
  • AI innovation and production reliability.
  • Startup speed and enterprise-grade rigor.
  • Long-term platform strategy and immediate technical execution.

They should be opinionated but not dogmatic, decisive but not reckless, and pragmatic without accepting mediocrity. They should be able to simplify complex systems, identify the real technical risks, and force clarity where teams are stuck in ambiguity.

Compensation and Benefits

Salary Range: Base Salary Range $300,000- $385,000 + Bonus + Stock Equity.

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.

Our posted salary range is done in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region, town, or cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers that allow employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount budgeted internally, and internal equity for the same position within the company.

Benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • $0 monthly premium and other flexible medical, dental, and vision plans effective on the first day of employment.
  • 401k plan.
  • Discretionary Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays.
  • Parental Leave.
  • Equity.
  • Monthly Wellness Reimbursement.
  • Monthly Lunch on Legion.

ABOUT LEGION

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.

Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.

For more information, visit https://legion.co

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.

DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION

For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co

Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

How We Determine What We Pay

As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.

Job Applicant Privacy Policy

This Job Applicant Privacy Policy (“Policy”) describes how Legion Technologies, Inc. (“Legion”, “we”, “us” and “our”) collects, uses, and discloses “personal information” as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California.

This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the Legion Privacy Policy applies.

  1. Types of Personal Information We Handle

    We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes:

    • Identification and contact information, and related identifiers such as full name, date and place of birth, citizenship and permanent residence, home and business addresses, telephone numbers, email addresses, and such information about your beneficiaries or emergency contacts.
    • Professional or employment-related information, including:
      • Recruitment, employment, or engagement information such as application forms and information included in a resume, cover letter, or otherwise provided through any application or engagement process; and copies of identification documents, such as driver’s licenses, passports, and visas; and background screening results and references.
      • Career information such as job titles; work history; work dates and work locations; information about skills, qualifications, experience, publications, speaking engagements, and preferences; and professional memberships
    • Education Information such as institutions attended, degrees, certifications, training courses, publications, and transcript information.
    • Legally protected classification information such as race, sex/gender, religious/ philosophical beliefs, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service, nationality, ethnicity, request for family care leave, political opinions, and criminal history.
    • Other information such as any information you voluntarily choose to provide in connection with your job application.

  2. How We Use Personal Information

    We collect, use, share, and store personal information from job applicants for our and our service providers’ business and operational purposes in the recruitment process such as: processing your application, tracking your application through the recruitment process, contacting references with your authorization, conducting background checks you authorize, and making hiring decisions. We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions.

  3. With Whom We Share Personal Information

    We will disclose job applicant personal information to the following types of entities or in the following circumstances (where applicable):

    • Internally: to other Legion personnel involved in the recruiting and hiring process.
    • Vendors: such as technology service providers, travel management providers, human resources suppliers, background check companies, and employment agencies or recruiters, where applicable.
    • Legal Compliance: when required to do so by law, regulation, or court order or in response to a request for assistance by the police or other law enforcement agency.
    • Litigation Purposes: to seek legal advice from our external lawyers or in connection with litigation with a third party.
    • Business Transaction Purposes: in connection with the sale, purchase, or merger.
  4. How to Contact Us About this Policy – If you have any questions about this Policy, please contact privacy@legion.co.

description: emerchantpay is a leading global payment service provider and acquirer for online, mobile, in-store and over the phone payments. Our global payments solution is available through a simple integration, offering a diverse range of features, including global acquiring, global and local payment methods, advanced fraud management and performance optimisation. We empower businesses to design seamless and engaging payment experiences for their consumers. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our AI Engineering team and help design, build, and roll out production-grade AI solutions, with a strong focus on AI engineering, AI agents, agentic workflows, machine learning, GenAI, and LLM-based applications . This is a senior individual contributor role within the AI Engineering team. The Senior AI Engineer will work closely with the AI Tech Lead , engineering teams, product stakeholders, data teams, cloud/platform teams, and security teams to deliver reliable AI capabilities into real business systems. The technology stack is diverse and can include Python (FastAPI/Flask/Django) or equivalent frameworks; React on the frontend side, and various ML/AI frameworks, APIs, cloud-native services, along with modern AI tooling . The role will have a strong focus on AWS , including Amazon Bedrock , Amazon Bedrock AgentCore , Amazon SageMaker , and other AWS AI/ML services. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain AI-powered applications, services, and integrations as part of the AI Engineering team. Implement solutions focused on AI agents, agentic workflows, automation, LLM-based applications, and AI-assisted business processes . Build and integrate AI applications using technologies such as Python (FastAPI/Flask/Django) or equivalent frameworks, React frontends, and relevant AI/ML frameworks . Implement AI solutions using AWS AI/ML services , including Amazon Bedrock , Amazon Bedrock AgentCore , Amazon SageMaker , and other AWS services for model hosting, inference, orchestration, data processing, monitoring, and security. Work closely with the AI Tech Lead to align on architecture, technology choices, engineering standards, AI patterns, and rollout approaches. Provide technical input and guidance to other engineers on AI implementation patterns, code quality, testing, observability, and production readiness. Develop and integrate AI agents that interact with internal APIs, business workflows, enterprise systems, knowledge bases, and external tools in a safe and controlled way. Build and maintain RAG-based solutions , including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval logic, reranking, and grounding techniques. Support the development and deployment of machine learning models and AI solutions into production environments. Contribute to ML pipelines and MLOps practices , including data preparation, model training, experiment tracking, model deployment, monitoring, evaluation, and lifecycle management. Integrate LLMs through APIs. Implement AI evaluation approaches for LLM outputs, RAG quality, agent behavior, model performance, hallucination detection, safety, and reliability. Support prompt engineering, prompt versioning, function calling, tool use, memory patterns, guardrails, and LLM application testing. Design and consume APIs and contribute to cloud-based, scalable backend architectures. Collaborate with product managers, engineers, data scientists, DevOps, security, and business stakeholders to deliver practical AI solutions. Write clean, maintainable, testable, and well-documented code. Support production rollouts, troubleshooting, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement of AI systems. Stay current with modern AI technologies, frameworks, models, and engineering practices, and bring practical recommendations to the team. Requirements Minimum 7-8 years of professional experience in software engineering, AI engineering, ML engineering, data science, or related technical roles. At least 2-3 years of experience in AI development, ML engineering, or data science , with a demonstrated track record of deploying machine learning models and AI solutions in production environments. Strong hands-on experience building production-grade AI, ML, and data-driven systems . Practical experience with AI agents, agentic workflows, LLM-based applications, tool-calling architectures, workflow automation, and AI orchestration patterns . Strong understanding of modern AI concepts, including deep learning, generative AI, LLMs, embeddings, RAG, LLM fine-tuning, and AI evaluation . Strong Python development experience, including experience with Python (FastAPI/Flask/Django) or equivalent frameworks . Some experience with React for building user-facing AI tools, internal applications, dashboards, or workflow interfaces. Strong knowledge of AWS , including practical experience with cloud-native architectures, Amazon Bedrock , Amazon Bedrock AgentCore , Amazon SageMaker , and related AWS AI/ML services (t he more, the better) Experience with advanced LLM frameworks such as LangChain , LlamaIndex , Semantic Kernel , CrewAI , AutoGen , or similar agent/orchestration frameworks. Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow , and familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers . Hands-on experience using LLMs via APIs, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini , or similar providers. Experience with ML pipelines and MLOps , including data preparation, model training, model deployment, experiment tracking, model/version management, monitoring, evaluation, and production support. title: Studio Director
description:
As Studio Director, you will lead the end-to-end operation of Suitsupply's photo studio, ensuring the efficient delivery of high-quality visual assets across every customer touchpoint. You will drive operational excellence through process optimization, resource planning, and technology enablement, partnering closely with Creative, Brand, Merchandising, Marketing, E-Commerce, and Production teams. This role calls for a strong operational mindset, balancing quality, speed, cost, and capacity while identifying opportunities to simplify processes and increase productivity. You will own the studio's technology roadmap, including AI-driven solutions, and lead a cross-functional network of photographers, stylists, retouchers, and producers. Your leadership will directly shape the scalability, efficiency, and creative output of one of Suitsupply's core content production functions. 
What You Will Do 
  • Lead day-to-day studio operations — managing capacity, resource allocation, schedules, and workload planning — and ensure output is delivered on time, on budget, and to quality standards. 
  • Coordinate photographers, stylists, retouchers, and producers, and establish KPIs and reporting to track throughput, turnaround, utilization, and quality. 
  • Own and continuously improve end-to-end studio workflows, using production data and bottleneck analysis to eliminate inefficiencies and drive scalable ways of working. 
  • Evaluate, implement, and optimize technologies for production planning, asset management, and workflow automation, leveraging AI to accelerate content production and improve quality control. 
  • Build business cases for technology investments and drive adoption across the studio team, partnering with Technology and Digital teams. 
  • Serve as the primary operational point of contact for studio matters across Creative, Brand, Marketing, Merchandising, Retail, E-commerce, and Production teams. 
  • Manage external partners — retouching, production, equipment, and technology vendors — negotiating contracts and rates to ensure cost-effective, high-quality service. 
  • Own the studio operating budget across external retouching, tooling, technology, equipment, and resources, monitoring productivity, utilization, and costs to optimize spend. 
  • Support strategic planning and future studio capability development. 
Who You Are 
  • 10+ years in studio operations, content production, or related operational leadership, with proven experience managing high-volume production in fashion, retail, e-commerce, or a comparable industry. 
  • Strong operational and analytical mindset, using data and metrics to improve workflows, simplify processes, and drive efficiency. 
  • Experience implementing new technologies, workflow management systems, and AI-enabled solutions; hands-on with platforms such as Creative Force, Photoshop, and Figma. 
  • Strong project, stakeholder, and resource management skills across competing priorities and deadlines. 
  • Commercially minded, with experience managing budgets, vendors, and operational performance. 
  • Self-directed, pragmatic, and solution-oriented, with strong ownership and accountability. 
  • Bachelor's degree in Photography, Creative Production, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred. 
What You Will Get 
  • Autonomy: We empower you to take ownership, make meaningful decisions, and drive impact without layers of sign-off. 
  • Growth: We see your potential as a key asset. At Suitsupply, you'll have abundant opportunities to learn, grow, and excel in a supportive environment that encourages development at every step. 
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Our commitment to sustainability and ethical business is unwavering. We work exclusively with suppliers who uphold the highest standards, in alignment with the International Labour Organization. 
  • Style: Immerse yourself in a world of beautifully crafted, high-quality products, and enjoy a 40% discount on Suitsupply products.
  • Compensation: We offer a competitive salary of based on relevant skills and experience.

title: Senior Embedded Performance Engineer
description:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Performance Engineer who is passionate about getting the most out of embedded systems — from low-level Linux tuning and hardware integration to high-performance video and data pipelines. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to hardware, moving across the stack, and solving the kinds of problems where milliseconds, bandwidth, startup time, and system efficiency matter.

You will work across the AuterionOS ecosystem on topics such as:

  • Embedded Linux performance and system tuning
  • Low-latency video streaming and media pipelines
  • C/C++, Python, and Bash-based platform development
  • Hardware integration, system profiling, and end-to-end optimization
  • Collaboration with experienced and driven engineers across Auterion

Responsibilities

  • Work within the Apps & Simulation team and collaborate with other development teams to build high-performance products for autonomous systems.
  • Design, optimize, and maintain performance-critical components within AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.
  • Improve end-to-end system behavior across compute, networking, video, and hardware interfaces, with a strong focus on latency, throughput, reliability, and resource efficiency.
  • Analyze and optimize demanding workloads such as real-time telemetry, video streaming, media processing, and communication between distributed system components.
  • Investigate system bottlenecks across the full stack, from kernel and OS behavior to application-level code and tooling.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases, and translate them into robust technical solutions.
  • Propose and implement new platform capabilities with a strong emphasis on measurable performance gains in real-world deployments.
  • Participate in daily stand-ups, release planning, and prioritization discussions.

Qualifications and Skills

  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience writing object-oriented C++ and/or Python.
  • Deep experience with embedded Linux systems, including cross-compilation, debugging, profiling, and performance tuning.
  • Strong hands-on background in diagnosing and optimizing real-world system behavior, including CPU, memory, I/O, networking, boot time, and application latency.
  • Experience building or optimizing low-latency video or data-streaming pipelines, ideally on embedded platforms.
  • Excellent understanding of software systems that span embedded devices, higher-level applications, and fully integrated products.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, implementation, debugging, and testing.
  • Experience with video codecs, GStreamer, RTP/RTSP, or hardware-accelerated media pipelines.
  • Solid experience with Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, Bash scripting, and systemd.
  • Experience with Docker and docker-compose in complex development and deployment environments, as well as qemu.
  • Strong debugging and performance analysis skills at both system and application level, combined with a proactive and self-directed working style.
  • Proficient in ROS2/DDS-style middleware and experienced with networking across multiple OSI layers, including REST APIs and performance-sensitive communication paths.
  • Experience with system integration and interfacing sensors or peripherals, especially via USB and Ethernet.
  • Experience working in an agile engineering environment with stand-ups, sprint planning, and shared ownership across teams.
  • Bonus: Experience with build systems such as CMake, including improving build performance in large-scale software projects.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Company pension plan 
  • Car parking  
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Mental health and wellbeing support
  • Learning and development opportunities

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

Job description :

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and technical teams to analyze business needs, define requirements, and ensure successful delivery of features within an Agile/SAFe environment.

The role involves managing the product backlog, preparing and refining user stories, facilitating requirements workshops, supporting PI Planning and sprint execution, and coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT). The ideal candidate will have knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power BI, Power Pages, and Dataverse, as well as the ability to leverage AI tools to improve requirements gathering and business process analysis.

Key responsibilities :

  • Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders, Product Owners, and SMEs to gather, analyze, validate, and document business and technical requirements.

  • Feature & Backlog Management: Analyze upcoming roadmap features, identify business value, dependencies, risks, and gaps, and continuously refine the product backlog.

  • User Stories & Acceptance Criteria: Create and refine Epics, Features, and User Stories with clear scope, detailed acceptance criteria, dependencies, and relevant functional and non-functional requirements.

  • Business Process Documentation: Prepare process flows (as-is/to-be), mockups, business rules, data mappings, impact assessments, and other supporting documentation as required.

  • Microsoft Power Platform: Understand Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven), Power BI, Power Pages, Dataverse, access structures, data models, solution architecture, and inbound/outbound data flows.

  • Agile & SAFe Delivery: Participate in PI Planning, backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily meetings, system demos, and other Agile/SAFe ceremonies.

  • PI Preparation: Support pre-PI planning activities, identify knowledge gaps and dependencies, prepare refinement materials, and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure feature readiness.

  • Definition of Ready & Definition of Done: Ensure that User Stories meet the agreed Definition of Ready (DoR) before entering a sprint and contain the necessary information to support the Definition of Done (DoD).

  • Technical & Cross-Team Coordination: Collaborate with development leads, testers, Product Owners, and other teams to clarify technical feasibility, resolve dependencies, and maintain alignment on scope and responsibilities.

  • User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Prepare UAT scenarios, use cases, and sample test data; coordinate end-user testing; collect and analyze feedback; and document decisions and follow-up backlog items.

  • Delivery & Release Support: Verify that delivered functionality meets business requirements, prepare sprint release notes, and ensure that documentation, user guidance, and training materials are updated.

  • Documentation & Traceability: Maintain centralized and accessible project documentation in tools such as SharePoint or Wiki, ensuring traceability from Epics and Features through User Stories, acceptance tests, and releases.

  • AI-Assisted Analysis: Use AI capabilities such as Copilot, AI agents, and other relevant tools to support requirements gathering, process analysis, validation of assumptions, and initial solution ideation.

title: Meewerkstage: Communicatie
description: Wat ga je doen? Hoe zorg je ervoor dat 800+ collega’s wereldwijd weten wat er binnen Voortman speelt én zich betrokken voelen bij de organisatie? Met verschillende vestigingen, landen, afdelingen en groepen collega’s is dat een mooie communicatie-uitdaging. Want niet iedere doelgroep bereik je op dezelfde manier en niet ieder verhaal vertel je via hetzelfde kanaal. Als stagiair Communicatie draai je volop mee binnen ons communicatieteam. Je staat midden in de organisatie en spreekt collega’s van allerlei afdelingen: van productie en engineering tot service en sales. Je ontdekt wat er speelt, haalt verhalen en ontwikkelingen op en denkt mee over hoe we die op een interessante en relevante manier onder de aandacht brengen bij onze verschillende doelgroepen. Daarbij werk je met allerlei vormen van communicatie en content. De ene keer schrijf je een artikel of werk je mee aan een magazine, de andere keer denk je mee over een video of ondersteun je bij de communicatie rondom een grote interne bijeenkomst voor honderden collega’s. Je kijkt steeds naar wat je wilt vertellen, wie je wilt bereiken en welke vorm daar het beste bij past. Concreet ga je onder andere: verhalen en ontwikkelingen ophalen bij collega’s uit verschillende delen van de organisatie; helpen bij het plannen, voorbereiden en publiceren van content (tekst, video, offline materialen); ondersteunen bij de organisatie en communicatie rondom grote interne bijeenkomsten; nieuwe formats en creatieve manieren bedenken om verhalen binnen Voortman te vertellen; kijken hoe we sterke interne content slim kunnen doorvertalen naar externe middelen voor bijvoorbeeld employer branding; Je doet dit natuurlijk niet alleen. Je werkt nauw samen met het communicatieteam en onze collega’s van Marketing. Binnen het bredere team zijn verschillende specialisten aanwezig, onder andere op het gebied van foto, video en contentcreatie. Daardoor krijg je de kans om met verschillende disciplines samen te werken én veel kanten van het communicatievak te ontdekken. Je krijgt veel ruimte om zelf ideeën aan te dragen, initiatief te nemen en dingen uit te proberen. En doordat je voor je content met collega’s uit de hele organisatie samenwerkt, zit je echt centraal in Voortman. Een veelzijdige communicatiestage waarin je veel van de organisatie ziet, veel mensen leert kennen en vooral ook veel zelf gaat maken. Wij vragen Hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van communicatie, creative business, journalistiek of vergelijkbaar; Je hebt een professionele, pakkende schrijfstijl en vindt het leuk om content te maken; Je bent nieuwsgierig, proactief en stapt gemakkelijk op collega’s af; Je hebt gevoel voor verschillende doelgroepen en denkt graag na over hoe je hen het beste bereikt. Wij bieden Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand; Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt; Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software; Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen; Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Over Voortman Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Deal Desk Analyst - Dublin
description:
As a Senior Deal Desk Analyst, you will work cross-functionally with our Sales Operations, Billing, Contracts and Legal teams to provide quoting and deal structuring support to the Global Sales Team. This will be a growth position as Datadog’s business continues to expand.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop in-depth knowledge of Datadog’s licensing and pricing models to provide deal structuring and quoting support to our global sales teams  
  • Be a creative problem solver who finds a way to meet customers’ needs while adhering to Datadog’s selling policies
  • Solve customer satisfaction issues following execution of the deal
  • Actively negotiate deals directly with the customer as needed
  • Work cross functionally across various stakeholder groups including legal, contracts, sales operations, order management, revenue, finance and product management
  • Function as point of contact and subject matter expert for Sales on deal pricing matters
  • Drive adherence to internal controls, protocols and business rules

Who You Are:

  • Experienced in 4+ years of Deal Desk experience
  • Confident in deal structuring/quoting complex SaaS transactions for a fast-growing global company  
  • Knowledgeable of revenue recognition principles 
  • Comfortable representing the company to customers in negotiations and resolving customer satisfaction issues  
  • Strong in your attention to detail and communication skills
  • Able to work independently and multi-task in fast paced, high pressure environment
  • Data-driven with strong quantitative skills 
  • Analytical with the ability to approach a problem from multiple perspectives

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with Salesforce and CPQ
  • Advance level with MS Excel or similar.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth: 

  • Generous and competitive benefits package
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
  • Pet adoption assistance and insurance program
  • Continuous career development and pathing opportunities 
  • Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space
  • Best in breed onboarding
  • Internal mentor and buddy program cross-departmentally
  • Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

title: Agentic AI Principal
description:
We are looking for an Agentic AI Principal to act as a senior technical authority and trusted client advisor for complex agentic AI transformation in Germany, the Netherlands and the wider DACH region.

Operating at Principal level, you will shape enterprise AI strategy, define agentic architecture blueprints, lead high-value C-suite engagements and guide complex programmes from opportunity through delivery. You will bring deep hands-on credibility in multi-agent systems, governance and safeguards, while setting reusable patterns and raising capability across teams.

The role has particular focus on sovereign, compliant and production-grade agentic AI for regulated German, Dutch and European enterprises, with a primary focus on healthcare and life sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech and healthcare providers). Experience from other regulated sectors, such as financial services and insurance, automotive and manufacturing, energy and telecommunications, is equally welcome.

Our delivery model is moving from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first, multidisciplinary pods accountable to a business outcome. You will anchor the agentic side of that work, pairing with our data, tech advisory and industry domain leads from presale through delivery.

This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation.

Job responsibilities

Shaping and winning

  • Agentic AI advisory and strategy: shape and solution complex German, Dutch and DACH pursuits with account, commercial and delivery leaders, translating client needs into differentiated propositions, credible architectures and executable delivery approaches that support regional pipeline conversion.
  • Independently drive complex pursuits with technical and executive stakeholders, including shaping the commercial model (fixed-price, outcome-linked), trade-offs and risk.
  • Act as a sparring partner to C-suite buyers (CEO, CIO, CDO, CISO, COO): frame business-outcome hypotheses, challenge assumptions and define a thin slice of agentic delivery that proves value quickly.
  • Lead AI maturity assessments, identify and prioritise processes for agentisation, and connect architecture choices to measurable business value and ROI.
  • Represent Thoughtworks' agentic AI expertise in strategic client conversations, industry forums, partnerships and thought leadership where appropriate.

Designing and building

  • Design and build engineering: set the architecture direction for complex, production-grade agentic AI systems, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, memory, context strategy, retrieval, evaluation, observability and enterprise integration.
  • Integrate agents with the German enterprise core: SAP (S/4HANA, BTP), LIMS, QMS and clinical systems, MES/PLM and industrial systems, and legacy back-office platforms, using open protocols such as MCP and A2A where they fit.
  • Ensure agents run on trustworthy data foundations, working with data engineering and data product teams on data quality, semantics and access.
  • Design solutions for regulated German and EU environments, with strong consideration of data sovereignty (EU and German sovereign cloud, open-weight or self-hosted models where required), privacy, security, responsible AI and applicable regulation, including the EU AI Act and GDPR; for healthcare and life sciences GxP, EU MDR/IVDR and the European Health Data Space; and for other sectors DORA, NIS2 and BaFin requirements where relevant.
  • Guide teams in balancing rapid experimentation with robust production engineering, including evaluation-driven development, testing, CI/CD, reliability, cost and performance optimisation.
  • Provide technical and delivery leadership for complex programmes, staying hands-on enough to validate architecture, unblock teams, manage technical risk and ensure successful execution.
  • Partner with product, data, software engineering, enterprise architecture, governance and change specialists to design end-to-end solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

Governance and safeguards

  • Establish reusable patterns for observability, auditability, traceability and control of agentic systems, enabling teams to demonstrate safe and reliable behaviour in production.
  • Translate EU AI Act obligations (risk classification, human oversight, logging, technical documentation, GPAI-provider responsibilities) into concrete engineering controls and evidence.

Principal-level leadership and growing capability 

  • Set reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards and governance practices across multiple teams and engagements, influencing the evolution of Thoughtworks' agentic AI capability beyond an individual programme.
  • Set technical direction across multiple teams and initiatives, defining reusable patterns, frameworks and engineering standards for agentic AI delivery.
  • Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, build the next generation of the German team, and raise AI fluency and agentic engineering standards across specialists and generalists.
  • Evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and frameworks and guide their responsible adoption based on client context, engineering quality and business value.
  • Build our German and Dutch market presence through local-language points of view, ecosystem and partner initiatives (hyperscalers, SAP, European model providers) and community events.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

  • Deep expertise in modern software engineering and Python, with a strong track record of setting standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, maintainability and production reliability.
  • Recognised experience architecting and delivering complex GenAI and agentic AI systems at enterprise scale, from early discovery through production deployment.
  • Deep knowledge of agentic architectures and frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex or equivalent, including tool use, orchestration, memory, multi-agent coordination and interoperability protocols (MCP, A2A).
  • Strong expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation, advanced information retrieval, vector databases and enterprise knowledge integration.
  • Experience designing evaluation strategies for GenAI and agentic systems, including quality, safety, reliability, latency and cost measures.
  • Strong understanding of AI governance and safeguards, including guardrails, red-teaming, observability, responsible AI and secure deployment practices (prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse).
  • Significant experience deploying AI systems on major cloud platforms using containers, orchestration and production-grade infrastructure patterns, including EU sovereign cloud, hybrid or on-premises setups and self-hosted open-weight models.
  • Experience with model adaptation and optimisation techniques, including prompt/context engineering, fine-tuning where appropriate, and application-level performance optimisation.
  • Ability to make sound architecture trade-offs across model capability, reliability, security, compliance, performance and cost.
  • Working knowledge of the EU AI Act, GDPR and sector rules (for healthcare and life sciences: GxP and GAMP 5 computerised-system validation, EU MDR/IVDR, EHDS; for other sectors: DORA, NIS2, BaFin) and how they shape agentic system design.

Consulting and Commercial Track Record

description: Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves. HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day. As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you. You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together. You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date. You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence. You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law. You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter. You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like. You have several years of experience in software or ML engineering. Depth in recent projects counts for more than years. Strong experience in agentic AI. You have good knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries. You have helped build an LLM application that runs in production. Not just prototypes, notebooks or courses. You have hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or comparable orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer (RAG) setup is not enough. You have measured the quality of an LLM system with evaluation sets or observability, and can give a concrete example. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus. You have back-end experience, including building REST APIs. You have experience in Kubernetes. Experience with Postgres is useful. Experience in a legal, tax or other knowledge-intensive domain is a plus. WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck. A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction. Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet. Base salary between €4,477 and €5,793 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below). A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%. 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it. A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance. A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance. Collective insurance plans. A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement. Two days a week in the office in The Hague, within walking distance of Voorburg station. The rest of the week, wherever you work best. Room to grow: in your craft, in your role, in the organization. WANT TO KNOW MORE? We'd love to tell you everything about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you'll hear from us within 2 working days. Any questions first? Text or call Nadine at 0628556265. title: International Expansion
description: About Us At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the Dutch market. Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen. This role will assess Axle’s participation in Dutch markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace. You speak Dutch and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset. What you will be doing Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue. High-level strategy development, defining and executing Axle’s international expansion plans, and assessing the commercial value of Dutch markets and business models. Diving deep into policy and regulations, understanding how market access works and what needs doing to achieve it. Developing the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships with key stakeholders. You’ll be jumping on the phone (and eventually, getting on the ground) with grid operators, utilities/retailers and potential clients to create and disprove hypotheses as quickly as possible. Acting as a conduit between partners and engineering teams creating fast, structured feedback loops that help translate field insights into meaningful product enhancements. As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets. You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments. This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification. What’s in it for you This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience. We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. You’ll be based in the Netherlands. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.   • Set up and secure new employee devices (MDM), manage access provisioning/deprovisioning

  • Keep an eye on emerging attack techniques targeting generative AI (prompt injection, jailbreaks, content filter bypass)

  • Solid experience in application security (code review, vulnerability management)

  • Experience coordinating or conducting penetration tests / security audits

  • Comfortable shipping code and working with Git/GitHub workflows

  • Bonus: familiarity with AI/LLM security concepts (prompt injection, jailbreaking, adversarial testing) — this is still an emerging field, so curiosity matters more than proven experience

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🧢 Goal-orientated, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and we need people who can find the right balance between executing, planning and strategy

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together

⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on. The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running. Tala is seeking a driven engineer to join our growing Product Development team. The ideal candidate is adept at problem-solving and debugging, and is committed to continuously improving existing systems and processes. You will work closely with fellow Tala engineers to build and extend Tala's backend architecture to support new country launches, new features, and a fast growing user base. The Senior Backend Engineer owns systems and initiatives that span a domain. You set your own technical approach, need minimal technical guidance, and raise the domain's quality bar through design, review, and partnership with peers. As a technologist and a leader, you push the team toward a highly available, scalable, reliable, fault tolerant, and performant microservices platform. You follow and improve Tala's engineering processes and standards while advancing Tala's mission and business objectives. This is a technical leadership role within Tala's technical track, set in a supportive team environment with significant opportunities for career advancement and professional development. You will collaborate cross-functionally with teams across the globe. Key Responsibilities Design and Engineering Design, develop, and maintain backend services, APIs, and data integration layers that power key product features. Author design documents (EDDs) for services in the domain and defend them in review. Design and optimize database schemas and queries for performance and system reliability. Meet project goals without trading away quality, and pay down technical debt as part of delivery rather than as a separate request. Serve as the go-to person for one or more technologies in the domain, following industry developments and explaining concretely how they would or would not apply at Tala. Quality, Review, and Standards Hold the domain's engineering bar in code and design reviews, including for work from other technical teams. Write clean, maintainable code that follows established coding standards. Contribute to the testing infrastructure to increase coverage for backend modules. Verify AI-assisted changes to the same standard as hand-written code. Reliability and Operations Define alerting, SLIs, and SLOs, and advance monitoring of backend modules so availability and response times improve proactively. Handle incidents that the runbook does not cover, fill runbook gaps found during a shift, lead the technical response for domain incidents, and write the RCA. Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues quickly across development and production environments. Delivery and Collaboration Own delivery of domain roadmap work and take part in quarterly and sprint planning with a view on feasibility. Anticipate blockers before sprint commitment, and escalate with a problem statement, an impact assessment, and proposed options. Work with Product and business stakeholders to remove ambiguity and to understand what success means for a feature. Work with the team lead to deliver domain solutions, and own service design and implementation end to end, including regressions you introduce. Keep the domain's tickets accurate and its documentation complete enough that it is the first place people look. Work across multiple time zones using asynchronous communication. Mentorship Act as a dedicated mentor to junior and mid-level engineers, with a clear sense of what each is working to improve. Technically lead and mentor a team of Backend Engineers building or extending complex modules. Required Skills and Experience Language: Fluency in English, including clear written communication, which is how most work happens across time zones. Backend engineering: Hands-on experience designing, building, and operating applications in Java, Kotlin, and/or Scala, including a web framework such as Spring. Track record: Has led and delivered multiple domain-significant projects, each validated in production over a meaningful period, including large scale consumer applications on cloud infrastructure (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure) using microservices architecture. Technical expertise: Subject-matter expert in their own domain and conversant in adjacent ones. Maintains a working mental model of the wider company architecture and where the seams are. Assesses code and design quality beyond their own area. Solution building and system design: Designs services and their dependencies with security, maintainability, operability, and scale accounted for. Authors design documents (EDDs) and defend them in review. Designs for failure cases, not just the happy path. API design: Expert knowledge of REST API design and development for mobile and web use. Judgment and problem framing: Reframes poorly posed problems instead of answering them as asked. Decides with incomplete information and states the assumptions relied on. Distinguishes reversible from irreversible decisions and applies rigor accordingly. Choose the smallest solution that solves the problem. Data stores: Strong relational database experience (MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MS SQL) and strong non-relational database experience (Cassandra, Redshift, DynamoDB, or HDFS). Testing and observability: Defines alert thresholds, SLIs, and SLOs for the domain along with the telemetry that supports them. Designs for graceful degradation. Ships new features with monitoring already in place. Co-owns Acceptance Tests coverage decisions with SDET and flags testability gaps before release. Security and compliance: Follows Tala's security and privacy practices in line with ISO-27001 and ISO-27701, follows OWASP secure coding practices, and remediates vulnerabilities within established SLAs. AI fluency: Knows when not to delegate to AI and decomposes domain work into agent-sized units with explicit acceptance criteria. Builds reusable context assets, prompts, and skills that others in the domain adopt. Sets the verification bar for the domain's AI-assisted work. Is accountable for AI-generated code as if it were hand-written, and never puts PII, borrower or credit data, secrets, or production credentials into a prompt or agent context. Delivery and impact: Owns delivery of domain roadmap work and balances feature velocity against technical debt deliberately. Owns an outcome rather than a task list, knows which metrics their systems move, and watches them after release. Ways of working: Expert proficiency in the Agile development process. Prioritizes and communicates well in a fast-paced environment. Strong drive for independent learning and work. Compensation Additional Information

title: Stage Software Development
description: Stage Software Development Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende (afstudeer) stage, waarbij je in aanraking komt met de nieuwste ontwikkelmethodes? Wil je ervaren hoe het is om mee te bouwen aan een platform dat wereldwijd wordt gebruikt door duizenden gebruikers? Dan is een stage bij IXON wellicht iets voor jou! Bij IXON connecten wij machinebouwers met hun klanten en machines. Door machinebouwers wereldwijd toegang te geven tot hun machines en data zorgen wij voor een revolutie in industrial automation. Met onze end-to-end oplossing, bestaande uit een cloudplatform met geïntegreerde remote access, geven wij machinebouwers de tools en technologie in handen om hun businessmodellen te transformeren en daarmee toekomstbestendig te blijven. Dit alles met als doel: Efficiëntere productie met de laagst mogelijke impact op de wereld. Bouw jij mee? Verdeeld over verschillende SCRUM-teams is ons R&D-team verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen en ontwikkelen van het IXON Cloud-platform. Elk aspect van onze oplossing, dan de robuuste backend tot de gebruiksvriendelijke frontend, geavanceerde hardware en onze wereldwijde DevOps-infrastructuur, wordt met passie en expertise binnen onze muren ontwikkeld. Ons R&D-team, dat inmiddels bestaat uit meer dan 30 technische specialisten, staat altijd open voor jonge talenten die willen groeien en zich verder willen ontwikkelen. Tijdens elke stageperiode bieden we meerdere plekken aan voor studenten in de volgende deelgebieden: Backend development; Frontend development; Embedded Software Development; DevOps; Security; Software testing. Hierbij kom je aanraking met onze tech-stack, bestaande uit: Python; C++; Rust; Angular; Typescript; Playwright; Zabbix; Linux; MariaDB; Kubernetes; SALT. Uiteraard staan we altijd open voor inbreng van studenten op het gebied van nieuwe tooling, frameworks en technieken. Welke opdrachten kan je verwachten? Studio for e-mail Door de aanhoudende groei van het aantal IXON Cloud-gebruikers neemt de diversiteit aan specifieke wensen toe. Een veelgehoorde behoefte is het personaliseren van e-mailberichten die vanuit het platform naar de eindgebruikers worden verstuurd. Momenteel zijn de aanpassingsmogelijkheden beperkt tot enkel de kleuren en logo's. Het doel van deze opdracht is om klanten volledige controle te bieden over de vormgeving en inhoud van hun e-mails. Om dit te realiseren, wordt een intuïtieve e-mailstudio ontwikkeld waarmee de gebruiker eenvoudig en naar eigen inzicht berichten kan opstellen en beheren. Support Beckhoff ADS via pull application (Embedded Software Development) Implementeer ondersteuning voor het Beckhoff ADS-protocol in C++ om de compatibiliteit van de IXON data pipeline te vergroten. Je realiseert de volledige koppeling op de gateway en maakt data-logging eenvoudig configureerbaar in de fleet manager. Het versnellen van End-to-End (E2E) testen (Software testing) Optimaliseer de End-to-End testomgeving van de IXON Cloud om de feedbackcyclus en release-snelheid voor ontwikkelaars te verhogen. Je identificeert knelpunten en implementeert versnellingsoplossingen binnen de GitLab CI/CD-pipeline. Hier herken jij jezelf in Je bent een HBO student in de richting van (Embedded) Software Development, Security of aanverwant en bent op zoek naar een (afstudeer)stage met impact. Je hebt een passie voor het ontwikkelen van toffe softwareoplossingen en krijgt graag de vrijheid om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. Daarbij ga je niet voor shortcuts, maar werk je gestructureerd aan kwalitatieve oplossingen. Daarnaast ben je een echte teamplayer, die daardoor moeiteloos meedraait in een van onze SCRUM teams. Dit hebben wij jou te bieden Een mooie stagevergoeding; Een relaxte werkomgeving met jonge en ambitieuze developers, met wie je altijd kunt sparren over de nieuwste technologieën; Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om thuis te werken; Doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen onze organisatie. Wij geloven dat het geluk van de mens hem zit in het hebben van autonomie, een doel (purpose) en de kans om te groeien. Business control heeft daar een enorme impact op! Doordat de behaalde resultaten zichtbaar worden, kunnen deze gevierd worden en zie je direct hoe je zelf presteert en groeit binnen het bedrijf. Business control op R&D is best een uitdaging, want regels code tellen is niet de oplossing en de opbrengst van nieuwe producten is vaak nog lastig in te schatten. Jij gaat de uitdaging aan om toch controle te krijgen over de business! Hoewel geen dag hetzelfde is, houd jij je tijdens een gemiddelde werkweek onder andere bezig met de volgende activiteiten: De bestaande rapportagestructuur en kosten binnen de R&D-afdeling in kaart brengen; Het maken van een concreet uitrolplan (waaronder het bepalen van KPI's, rapportages en reviews); Meehelpen met rapportageverbeteringen en overkoepelend meekijken op de afdeling; Wanneer er tijd is: een pilot draaien met één van onze teams om jouw theorie in de praktijk te brengen. Dit maakt jou succesvol in deze rol Jij past perfect bij de pioniersgeest van onze organisatie. Dit betekent dat je niet bang bent om buiten de lijntjes te kleuren, initiatief te nemen en daardoor dus graag aan de slag gaat met nieuwe inzichten en projecten. Daarnaast ben je analytisch sterk, werk je graag zelfstandig en ben je van nature erg nieuwsgierig. Dit hebben wij jou te bieden Binnen deze rol krijg je de vrijheid en kans om een cruciale rol te spelen in het succes van een organisatie met enorme internationale marktpotentie. Hier krijg jij energie van


Tijdens deze stage van een half jaar (startende in februari) ga je aan de slag met de uitrol van Business Control binnen onze R&D-afdeling, waar dit op dit moment nog niet aanwezig is. Doordat de behaalde resultaten zichtbaar worden, kunnen deze gevierd worden en zie je direct hoe je zelf presteert en groeit binnen het bedrijf. Business control op R&D is best een uitdaging, want regels code tellen is niet de oplossing en de opbrengst van nieuwe producten is vaak nog lastig in te schatten. Jij gaat de uitdaging aan om toch controle te krijgen over de business!

Jij past perfect bij de pioniersgeest van onze organisatie.
