raw.jobDescription:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by

We’re looking for a Senior Director, Agentic Engineering to build and lead the platform, capabilities, and operating model that enable Lightspeed’s Product & Technology teams to work effectively with AI agents across the full product development lifecycle.

Reporting to the SVP, Engineering, this is a foundational leadership role with company-wide impact. You will turn rapidly evolving agentic technology into secure, reliable, and reusable capabilities that help teams discover, design, build, test, ship, and operate better products faster. Success will be measured not by experimentation alone, but by adoption and sustained improvements in product quality, engineering velocity, developer experience, and business outcomes.

Please note this role is based in the United States.

What you’ll be doing

  • Define the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for agentic engineering at Lightspeed, translating business and product priorities into a platform investment plan.

  • Build and lead the teams responsible for shared agentic platform capabilities, including reusable agents, workflow orchestration, context and knowledge access, tool integrations, evaluation, observability, and governance.

  • Create an extensible platform and paved-road experience that allows Product, Design, Engineering, Quality, and Operations teams to adopt agentic workflows without rebuilding core capabilities independently.

  • Partner with Retail, Hospitality, Payments, and platform leaders on highest-value product development use cases, launch them with early teams, and scale proven patterns across Lightspeed.

  • Establish a rigorous evaluation system for agent performance, output quality, reliability, security, cost, and human oversight so teams can use agents with confidence in production workflows.

  • Work closely with Security, Privacy, Legal, Data, and Architecture leaders to embed responsible AI, access controls, data protection, auditability, and risk management into the platform by design.

  • Define the operating model for agentic development, including standards, reusable patterns, ownership boundaries, enablement, support, and mechanisms for sharing learning across teams.

  • Drive adoption and change across a global organization by helping leaders redesign workflows, build team capability, and move from tool usage to measurable operating-model change.

  • Own outcome metrics for the platform, including adoption, active usage, developer and product experience, cycle-time improvement, quality, reliability, cost efficiency, and demonstrated business impact.

  • Hire, coach, and develop a strong leadership and technical bench, while building an inclusive, high-performing organization with high standards for execution and learning.

What you need to bring:

We’re looking for a senior engineering leader who can combine platform depth, AI fluency, product judgment, and enterprise change leadership. You should have experience with the following:

  • Leading leaders and senior technical talent in a software engineering organization, with a record of building high-performing teams through managers and staff-plus engineers.

  • Defining and scaling internal platforms, developer platforms, shared engineering capabilities, or infrastructure products in a complex, multi-product environment.

  • Building or deploying AI-enabled and agentic systems, including model and tool orchestration, retrieval and context systems, evaluation frameworks, automation, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls.

  • Partnering effectively with senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Security, Privacy, Legal, and business functions.

  • Leading organizational change across distributed teams, including workflow redesign, enablement, communication, and adoption at scale.

  • Establishing high standards for architecture, engineering quality, operational resilience, responsible AI, security, and cost management.

  • Communicating complex technical and strategic concepts clearly to executives, technical leaders, and cross-functional teams.

  • 15+ years of experience and Bachelor’s degree in CS or related field.

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

Be a changemaker

You’ll enjoy:

  • A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

  • A culture that celebrates performance

  • The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard

  • Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

  • Flexible paid time off and remote work policies

  • Equity options, because this is your company too

  • Contributions to your 401k. Your future matters

  • Training opportunities to grow your skills and career

  • Health and wellness credit so you feel your best

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams

  • Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook

  • Enhanced parental leave to support growing families

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

Please note that we ask applicants to disclose any criminal convictions, and we conduct criminal record checks as part of our hiring process for this role.

At Lightspeed, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your skillset, qualifications, experience, and market data. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We reasonably expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $300,000 to $360,000 USD, depending on the candidate’s location. Additionally, this role may be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. Lightspeed also provides a variety of employee benefits including, but not limited to, medical, dental, wellness, life and disability insurance, 401K plan and match, paid parental leave top-up, and paid time off.

Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within the United States, and refers to the amount Lightspeed is willing to pay at the time of this posting, which may vary depending on the candidate’s actual location. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

raw.description:
As OpenSpace's Solutions Consultant for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, you'll be the technical and commercial partner to our Account Executives. You'll win deals by proving the business value of OpenSpace, get new customers live quickly, and drive the adoption that turns first projects into long-term, growing accounts. You'll work across the whole customer lifecycle, from first demo through renewal, with regular visits to customer offices and job sites across the region.

What you will be doing

  • Owning the technical win with the Account Executive, from discovery and tailored demos through to a signed contract
  • Scoping, running and closing out pilots and proofs of value, with clear success criteria agreed with the AE and the customer
  • Finding and qualifying expansion opportunities in existing accounts and building pipeline with the AE
  • Leading the value and ROI conversation at renewal and expansion, using usage data and customer outcomes to build business cases
  • Onboarding new customers: project setup, capture training for field teams and admin training for project managers
  • Driving adoption after go-live through usage reviews, project check-ins and value reviews with customer stakeholders
  • Answering technical, security and data privacy (GDPR) questions, supporting tenders and RFPs, and advising on integrations such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma)
  • Bringing market feedback to the Product team and building German-language enablement material with Marketing

What we are looking for

  • A bachelor's degree in civil engineering, construction management, architecture or a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years in a customer-facing role at a construction technology or AEC software company, or in project or site management at an owner or construction company
  • A proven track record in pre-sales, solutions consulting or customer success with shared revenue targets
  • Native German and business-fluent English, spoken and written
  • Ability to travel regularly to customer offices and job sites across DACH
  • A solid understanding of how construction projects run, from preconstruction to handover, including site documentation and progress tracking
  • Experience with complex B2B sales cycles, value selling and qualification methods such as MEDDPICC
  • Familiarity with construction software such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma) and BIM tools
  • Reality capture or 360° imaging experience is a plus
  • Knowledge of the DACH construction market and its main contractors is a plus

How you like to work

  • Commercially minded: You spot expansion opportunities, build the ROI case and help the AE move deals forward. You can turn usage data into a clear story about customer value.
  • A clear communicator: You adapt your message to site managers, project managers and executives, and you explain technical concepts in plain language.

raw.jobDescription:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

We’re looking for a Solutions Architect to help build the technical foundation that powers Zip’s ERP and integration ecosystem. This role focuses on internal technical enablement, navigating complex customer environments to architect the cleanest possible solutions, partnering closely with Product, and driving best-in-class standards across all of Zip’s integration workflows - with a specific focus on the SAP ecosystem.

As Zip continues to scale rapidly across enterprise customers like Coinbase, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Snowflake, and Databricks, your impact will be foundational: creating reusable integration assets, defining standards of how the Zip product interacts with external systems.

You Will

You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams while reporting to Engineering to design, maintain, and iterate on Zip-owned ERP and integration templates that power scalable, repeatable customer implementations. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of future implementations are delivered, raising the technical bar for both our EPD teams and our customer-facing technical consultant organization.

  • Architect & standardize SAP integrations: Design, build, maintain, and iterate on Zip’s core SAP (ECC and S/4HANA) and Ariba integration templates, ensuring they deliver scalable, repeatable, and robust customer implementations.

  • Bridge product & the field: Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) to ensure integration templates stay perfectly aligned with core product architecture, field insights, and emerging customer needs.

  • Turn nuance into scale: Analyze complex customer implementations to identify reusable data mapping patterns and system nuances, converting bespoke solutions into standardized internal assets.

  • Support pre-sales engineering: Partner with account teams during pre-sales to design and vet integration architectures, ensuring prospective customers are set up for smooth, best-practice deployments.

  • Drive technical implementation excellence: Define, document, and champion technical solution consulting best practices, raising the technical bar and driving consistency across all implementations.

  • Become a Multi-ERP expert: Leverage your existing SAP, P2P, and module expertise (MM/FI) to build deep fluency across additional ERP ecosystems, ultimately becoming the ultimate subject matter expert on integration architecture, data models, and Zip’s App Studio.

  • Build for permanent scale: Approach every technical challenge with an engineering mindset - designing and executing a solution thoroughly once so that future implementations happen effortlessly. You balance high-level architectural design with a willingness to dive directly into API configurations and template modifications to get the job done right.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience delivering integrations with SAP ERP environments (ECC, S/4HANA) or procurement platforms (Ariba).

  • Strong foundational knowledge of core SAP business processes and data models within Materials Management (MM) and Financials (FI).

  • Familiarity with standard SAP integration methods, such as IDocs, BAPI/RFC, OData APIs, or SAP BTP/CPI.

  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools is preferred, but we welcome candidates with strong core integration logic who can learn new platform tools quickly.

  • Experience working with XML / REST based endpoints and standard authentication protocols.

  • Past ERP implementation, integration, configuration or administration experience is required.

  • Ability to translate highly technical information for audiences with varying degrees of technical knowledge.

  • Comfortable working with API documentation.

  • Comfortable testing and troubleshooting integration errors.

  • Able to understand customer requirements and document that information quickly, with little oversight

  • A continual learner and open to learning new technologies that Zip may integrate with in the future.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive.

  • Experience working with product and engineering teams.

  • Process-driven with a strong bias toward continuous improvement; you consistently look for opportunities to make systems better than you found them through systematic improvement.

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • Start-up equity

  • Health, vision & dental coverage

  • Team building events & happy hours

  • Flexible PTO

  • Apple equipment plus home office stipend

We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We look forward to hearing from you!

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. Our new product bets include routing and workforce management for physical operations. The portfolio has paying customers and early traction. You'll stay close to the work through production, customer adoption and scale. This is a technical leadership role with substantial hands-on engineering. You'll define important problems and make product and technical decisions alongside Product, Design and Engineering partners. You'll bring the judgement to move forward when requirements are incomplete, and the influence to align other teams around a clear direction. Lead ambiguous initiatives end to end, from discovery and prototypes through production rollout, adoption and iteration. Use customer feedback and product data to decide what to improve, expand or stop. Write and ship code on the critical path. Work across services, APIs and customer-facing experiences as the problem requires, combining technical depth with the ability to learn unfamiliar parts of the product. Set technical direction for your area and align the teams needed to deliver it. Make pragmatic architecture choices that support rapid learning today and reliable growth over time. Own the production quality of what you build. Design for correctness, reliability and performance, plan safe rollouts, and use operational evidence to address the constraints that emerge as usage grows. Increase the effectiveness of the engineers around you through design and code reviews, mentoring senior engineers, and removing recurring obstacles to delivery. Share context and decisions so others can move independently. Deep hands-on software engineering ability, with recent experience designing, implementing and operating production systems. You can move from a prototype to maintainable software and explain the trade-offs along the way. Experience scaling products and the systems behind them. You know how to identify the next constraint, balance speed with reliability, and make technical investments that support customer and business growth. Technical leadership across team boundaries. You have built alignment without formal authority, made other engineers more effective, and communicated difficult choices clearly to technical and business partners. Experience that could be useful Experience building B2B software through an early growth stage, or working on routing, workforce management or other software for physical operations. Your technical decisions support measurable business progress, and the teams around you can deliver more effectively because of your work. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. title: Software Engineer (Go)
description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The Role: As a Software Engineer within our Billing group, you will play a key role in developing core areas of our new billing platform. You’ll provide world-class experiences to thousands of customers who use and trust Paddle every day. You'll take the lead on discovering new features, planning their implementation, and contributing your technical expertise to shape the future of our billing platform. You’ll collaborate with multiple teams—engineers, product managers, and designers—working across a wide range of areas that will give you plenty of opportunities to develop your skills and grow your career as a valued member of our engineering team. What you'll do: Independently deliver on milestones that may span across multiple systems within Billing. Make changes with care and precision, recognising the importance of correctness when working with financial data. Contribute to systems designed for scale, reliability, and security, following established architectural patterns. Write clear, well-structured, and well-tested code that meets team standards. Participate in code reviews, both giving and receiving constructive feedback. Work closely with other engineers, product managers, and designers to understand requirements and deliver solutions. Break down larger pieces of work into manageable tasks and estimate your own work with guidance. Help monitor and support production services, investigating and fixing issues as they arise. Contribute to shaping our team and wider engineering culture to ensure Paddle remains an exceptional place to work. Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Data, Risk, and Operations to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions. Help shape product direction by providing technical insights, trade-offs, and delivery estimates. Partner with Customer Support or Operations teams to investigate and resolve production issues. We'd love to hear from you if you: You have a development background with Go. Have experience designing and building systems to handle high traffic at scale in a cloud-based environment in AWS Are someone who enjoys collaborating with our technical and non-technical departments Have a proactive attitude towards finding ways to improve the code and team processes. A strong understanding of the development process - from design through to deployment, maintenance, and what that means for day-to-day development. A strong understanding of API principles and best practices. A proven track record of bias for action and strong customer focus. Solid communication and collaboration skills, you should be comfortable working alongside both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Are someone who takes pride in what you build. Everyone is welcome at Paddle At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group. Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together. Why you’ll love working at Paddle We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture. raw.jobDescription:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The Role:

As a Software Engineer within our Billing group, you will play a key role in developing core areas of our new billing platform. You’ll provide world-class experiences to thousands of customers who use and trust Paddle every day. You'll take the lead on discovering new features, planning their implementation, and contributing your technical expertise to shape the future of our billing platform.

You’ll collaborate with multiple teams—engineers, product managers, and designers—working across a wide range of areas that will give you plenty of opportunities to develop your skills and grow your career as a valued member of our engineering team.

What you'll do:

  • Independently deliver on milestones that may span across multiple systems within Billing.

  • Make changes with care and precision, recognising the importance of correctness when working with financial data.

  • Contribute to systems designed for scale, reliability, and security, following established architectural patterns.

  • Write clear, well-structured, and well-tested code that meets team standards.

  • Participate in code reviews, both giving and receiving constructive feedback.

  • Work closely with other engineers, product managers, and designers to understand requirements and deliver solutions.

  • Break down larger pieces of work into manageable tasks and estimate your own work with guidance.

  • Help monitor and support production services, investigating and fixing issues as they arise.

  • Contribute to shaping our team and wider engineering culture to ensure Paddle remains an exceptional place to work.

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Data, Risk, and Operations to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.

  • Help shape product direction by providing technical insights, trade-offs, and delivery estimates.

  • Partner with Customer Support or Operations teams to investigate and resolve production issues.

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • You have a development background with Go.

  • Have experience designing and building systems to handle high traffic at scale in a cloud-based environment in AWS

  • Are someone who enjoys collaborating with our technical and non-technical departments

  • Have a proactive attitude towards finding ways to improve the code and team processes.

  • A strong understanding of the development process - from design through to deployment, maintenance, and what that means for day-to-day development.

  • A strong understanding of API principles and best practices.

  • A proven track record of bias for action and strong customer focus.

  • Solid communication and collaboration skills, you should be comfortable working alongside both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Are someone who takes pride in what you build.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

  • In APAC: Singapore

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

title: Research Engineer - Web Crawlers
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs, focused on large-scale web crawling for our frontier AI models. The quality of our models is bounded by the quality and scale of the data behind them, and you will own the crawling systems that source world-class data from the open web. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy: Building and operating large-scale, distributed web crawlers that discover, fetch, and extract data across billions of pages reliably and efficiently. Solving hard crawling problems such as content extraction from messy HTML, deduplication at web scale, freshness and recrawl strategies, and politeness and rate-limit handling. Creating tooling and infrastructure that lets researchers request, monitor, and explore newly crawled web data quickly and reliably. About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs, focused on large-scale web crawling for our frontier AI models. The quality of our models is bounded by the quality and scale of the data behind them, and you will own the crawling systems that source world-class data from the open web. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy:

  • Building and operating large-scale, distributed web crawlers that discover, fetch, and extract data across billions of pages reliably and efficiently.

  • Solving hard crawling problems such as content extraction from messy HTML, deduplication at web scale, freshness and recrawl strategies, and politeness and rate-limit handling.

  • Designing targeted crawling pipelines that find high-value data sources, including audio, video, and multilingual content, and turn them into clean training-ready datasets.

  • Creating tooling and infrastructure that lets researchers request, monitor, and explore newly crawled web data quickly and reliably.

Requirements

We do not require any formal certifications or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. Ideally, you bring:

  • Hands-on experience building and scaling web crawlers or scraping systems, ideally in support of machine learning training data.

  • Strong engineering skills in distributed systems at scale (e.g., Kubernetes, queue-based architectures, or custom pipelines processing billions of documents).

  • The capacity to autonomously evaluate the quality, coverage, and compliance of crawled data, and to build the tooling to measure it.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Senior AI Governance Specialist / Data Governance Consultant
description: Für unseren Kunden aus dem Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld suchen wir eine erfahrene Fachperson im Bereich AI Governance mit ergänzender Expertise in Data Governance und Data Quality. title: Software Engineer (Engineer III to Principal) - Formal Methods
description: Why us? Blockchain technology is enabling a rapidly-growing era of innovation for the digital world. It is crucial that blockchain code such as protocols and smart contracts are provably secure and correct. Once deployed, they are public and cannot be changed. Vulnerabilities and bugs in such programs regularly put millions of dollars at stake. This is where CertiK comes in. We are the leading blockchain security company. Our goal is to secure the cyber world by applying cutting edge techniques from academia to secure blockchain code. Come and join this ambitious mission as a research software engineer to work on automated analyses for provably secure and correct blockchain applications! What you will do You will design and develop tools that automatically ensure the correctness of smart contracts or identify security issues and bugs in smart contracts. We have software engineer positions available at all levels of seniority. Title and responsibilities will be commensurate with experience and background. As part of our multinational team of programming language experts, you will participate in the development of tools that rest upon techniques such as symbolic model checking, SAT/SMT solving, abstract interpretation, data flow analysis, and deductive verification. You will have the opportunity to work on all stages of tool development from idea generation to implementation and iterative improvements. Our team is highly supportive and collaborative with great opportunities to learn and grow. About you You have a background in programming language theory and automated reasoning and love to work on the forefront of applying results from theoretical computer science. You love to tackle computationally hard problems and have a proven track record of achieving results, where results are people using your tool to do their jobs. You are collaborative: you share ideas, love to brainstorm with peers, and give and receive feedback. You are comfortable with the unknown and understand that #startuplife means that you will be wearing multiple hats. Responsibilities Extend the scope and depth of our automated program verification tools and brainstorm, design, and implement new tools. Adapt and improve algorithms for symbolic software model checking. Examples include bounded model checking (BMC), counterexample-guided abstraction refinement (CEGAR), and property directed reachability (IC3/PDR). Build and extend translators from different input languages into intermediate representations, optimizing the generated models for automated analysis. Identify new classes of security properties of smart contracts and formalize properties for use in our automated verification tools. Closely collaborate with other software engineers in developing tools and set technical direction for solving problems in consultation with your team and management. Work on all aspects of delivering working software that meets customer needs, including analysis, design, automated testing, operations, CI/CD, measuring results, incorporating customer feedback, and support. Required Qualifications Master's Degree in Computer Science or a related field or 5 years of equivalent experience. Minimum of 4 years of software development experience (includes internships, software developed during research, and open-source development). Minimum of 2 years of experience with one or more of the following: model checking, formal verification, SAT/SMT solving (Z3, CVC4, Yices, MathSAT, SMTInterpol), abstract interpretation, or closely related disciplines. Demonstrated knowledge of fundamental computer science concepts such as data structures, algorithms, mathematical logic, and automata theory. Preferred Qualifications PhD in the broader field of automated reasoning. Publication record in conferences like POPL, CAV, TACAS, FMCAD, FM, etc. Experience in functional programming (OCaml or Haskell). Strong and creative problem-solving skills; always willing to learn and embrace new technologies and to collaborate. Prior experience in a professional software development environment. Compensation Additional Information About the Company Founded in 2018 by professors of Yale University and Columbia University, CertiK is a pioneer in blockchain security, utilizing best-in-class technology to secure and monitor blockchain protocols and smart contracts. CertiK’s mission is to secure the cyber world. Starting with blockchain, CertiK applies cutting-edge innovations from academia into enterprise, enabling mission-critical applications to be built with security and correctness. The exact compensation at which this job is filled will be determined by the skills and experience of qualified candidates. #LI-Remote #blockchain #startups #hiring CertiK is proud to offer medical, vision, and dental insurance, 401(k) plan with company matching, life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance, HSA (with high deductible plan), FSA, and other benefits to all full-time employees, along with flexible paid time off and holidays. Creative Fabrica is a fast-growing AI platform that makes it easy for everyday consumers to create whatever they imagine, from images and videos to audio and 3D creations, using the latest generative AI models.

idea.ai is our bet on what creative software looks like when AI is the default, not a feature.

About the role

As a Senior Backend Engineer (Go), you will be the architect of our multimodal generation pipeline. You won't just be building APIs; you’ll be designing the high-concurrency systems that orchestrate "heavy" AI workloads across any media domains. Your goal is to make complex, multi step AI generation feel instantaneous and reliable for a global audience of creators.

What you will do:

  • Orchestrate Multimodal Workflows: Design and scale Go-based microservices that manage the lifecycle of AI generations.
  • Performance Engineering: Optimize our ConnectRPC services and async processing pipelines (Kafka + SQS) to handle long-running, resource-intensive inference tasks without compromising platform stability.
  • Build the Creative Engine: Develop the backend logic for advanced features like multimodal orchestration.
  • Data & Infrastructure: Work with AWS to manage massive data throughput and integrate with high-performance storage and compute clusters.
  • Collaborate with AI Researchers: Bridge the gap between raw model outputs and a polished "One Person Studio" user experience.

What you will need:

  • Advanced Go Engineering: Extensive experience building and scaling Go services in high-traffic, high-volume SaaS environments.
  • Distributed Systems Mastery: Proven ability to design microservices that utilize asynchronous processing (Kafka & SQS) and low-latency communication (gRPC/ConnectRPC/GraphQL).
  • Cloud Architecture: Deep knowledge of AWS (EKS, S3, Lambda) and experience managing complex compute environments.
  • Product Rigor: A background in building professional-grade creative tools or media-heavy applications.
  • Software Best Practices: A quality-first mindset regarding code reviews, testing strategies, and observability.

Nice to have:

  • Media Processing Experience: Familiarity with handling varied media types (video transcoding, audio synthesis, vector manipulation).
  • AI Infrastructure: Experience with model serving at scale or managing GPU-accelerated workloads.
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Experience in a fast-paced environment where you help define the product vision and iterate quickly.

Is this you?

Get in touch! We'd love to speak to you.

You can apply by clicking the "Apply now" button.

We work from our Zoetermeer office with over 80 people and we grow every year. The culture is open and informal. You can push back on an idea regardless of title, and we change how we work when someone makes the case in retro.

About the role

You build frontend features that customers use the day you release them. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual.

Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt.

Claude Code is how our engineers write software. Everyone here uses it daily, and whole features now go out with an agent doing most of the coding. You still own what you merge, so you read the diff, you know why it works, and you can defend it in review. The interesting part of the job is deciding what to hand to an agent, what to write yourself, and what context the agent needs to get it right the first time.

You ask what a planner is trying to do before you read what the ticket says. You automate the parts of your own process that don't need a human.

Year one, in order

First, ship. Deliver features in scheduling and time tracking. Start small, then take one full feature from the product conversation through to release.

Then, own an area. Pick up a product surface end to end and become the person the team asks about it, including what it should do next. That covers how AI fits your area, which patterns you document for the agent and which calls you keep for yourself.

Along the way, make what you build safe to change. Restructure and test the paths you build on while you build on them. Extend test coverage where it's lacking. We move fast and keep quality up by automating what a human doesn't need to do, including the checks that catch what an agent got wrong.

What you'll do

  • Design and build frontend features starting from rough product ideas

  • Deliver features with Claude Code, from the prompt through to the pull request, and review the output as closely as a colleague's

  • Write the patterns, conventions and project context our agents work from, so generated frontend code lands in the right shape

  • Turn tangled domain rules into screens people can use without a manual

  • Fix bugs in your own features and in code you've never seen

  • Improve the code you touch while you touch it, so the next feature in that area costs less

  • Write and maintain automated tests in Jest and Playwright

  • Ship in short cycles with your product team

  • Pair, review, and teach what you know

How we work

Frontend in Angular, backend in PHP, a web app and a mobile app in React Native. Tests in Jest and Playwright. We develop AI-assisted with Claude Code as the primary tool, and a growing share of our code starts there. Human review and engineers owning what they ship keep it safe. We ship in short cycles in product teams with mixed specialisations. We pair often, with each other and with an agent open. Every quarter you get time to build and ship one of your own ideas, and we run hackathons.

3+ years of professional experience with an SPA framework, Angular preferred. Depth in React or Vue works if you can show you'll carry it over.

You ship. You've delivered features to real users at a steady pace, and you can tell us what you cut to get them out.

You automate your tests. Jest and Playwright, or equivalents, and you have an opinion about what deserves a test.

You simplify. Hand you a tangled domain problem and you produce a screen that hides the tangle.

You explain your choices. In review, in a design discussion, and to a product manager who doesn't read code.

You work as a peer. You pair, you review, and you make the people around you better without needing a title to be heard.

  • Claude Code in particular, or agent setups you've tuned for a team rather than yourself

  • TypeScript at depth

  • Storybook or component library ownership

  • React

  • PHP, or enough backend to reason about the API you're consuming

✅ You improve the code you touch without being asked, and you stop before it turns into a six-week rewrite

✅ You like a domain that takes months to learn

This probably isn't your dream job if…

⛔️ You want the technical approach decided before the ticket reaches you

⛔️ You want a job where AI stays out of your editor

title: Account Executive - NL Region
description: Dit is Shiftbase Meer dan 10.000 bedrijven. Ruim 250.000 gebruikers. Eén missie: personeelsplanning en tijdregistratie simpel maken. Ons platform is gebouwd om makkelijk, flexibel en schaalbaar te zijn, of je klant nu 15 of 2500 medewerkers heeft. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Zoetermeer en onze hub in Amsterdam werken 85+ collega's aan een product waar bedrijven blij van worden. De sfeer? Open, informeel en hands-on. Hier geen eindeloze vergadercycli. Wel korte lijnen, snelle beslissingen en ruimte om jezelf te zijn. Wat ga je doen? Als Account Executive voor de Nederlandse markt ben jij de persoon die kansen omzet in betalende klanten. Je bedient de B2B-markt over de volle breedte: van horeca tot retail, van zorg tot transport. Bedrijven die vaak nog met Excel of een verouderd systeem werken en waarbij jij in één demo laat zien hoeveel tijd ze terugkrijgen. De use case is herkenbaar, de waarde is snel duidelijk en dat maakt je verkoopcycli lekker kort. Het grootste deel van je pipeline is warm. Onze marketing levert continu leads aan van bedrijven die actief op zoek zijn, en dat gaat hard. Maar we willen niet afhankelijk zijn van alleen wat er binnenkomt. Je krijgt de ruimte, en de verwachting, om zelf ook kansen te creëren in accounts die je interessant vindt. Hoe we dat als team het beste aanpakken, bepalen we samen. Jouw ervaring in de praktijk weegt daarin mee. Het volledige sales process is van jou, van discovery en demo tot onderhandeling en close. Na de close draag je het account over aan ons Customer Success-team. Jij focust volledig op new business. Je werkt met tempo en volume, en je weet wanneer een deal aandacht verdient en wanneer je hem moet laten gaan. Je dag bestaat voor een groot deel uit bellen en demo's, want dit is een hands-on salesrol. Sporadisch ga je op pad naar een klant voor een persoonlijk gesprek. Je bouwt mee aan een groeiend salesteam binnen een snelgroeiende organisatie, en dat vraagt energie, initiatief en doorzettingsvermogen. Je deelt wat voor jou werkt met het team, want we worden hier beter van elkaar. Wie ben jij? Een salesprofessional met een paar jaar ervaring die energie krijgt van tempo, van veel gesprekken en van scoren. Je hebt bewezen dat je kunt presteren in een snelle SaaS-salesomgeving en je wilt nu een volgende stap zetten in een team dat hard aan het opbouwen is. Je wacht niet tot de telefoon gaat: als je een account in gedachten hebt, vind je zelf een weg naar binnen. Verder herkennen we je aan het volgende: je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in high-velocity software sales (SaaS), je bent commercieel scherp zonder je klant uit het oog te verliezen, je bent leergierig en staat open voor coaching, en je beheerst Nederlands uitstekend. Engels is een pre. Profielen die ons aanspreken: je komt uit de SaaS-wereld en hebt ervaring met snelle funnels en hoge volumes. Denk aan omgevingen zoals Lightspeed, Zenchef of vergelijkbare SME-gerichte hospitality- of retailtech. Of je hebt een leidinggevende achtergrond in de horeca, bent tech-savvy en hebt slimme techoplossingen geïmplementeerd in die rol, en je wilt nu de overstap maken naar software sales aan onder andere de horeca. In beide gevallen: je snapt de wereld van onze klanten als geen ander. Wat bieden wij jou? Een rol waarin je een SaaS-oplossing verkoopt die bedrijven écht vooruit helpt, in een omgeving waar resultaat en plezier hand in hand gaan. Groei is hier geen loze belofte. We investeren serieus in je ontwikkeling vanaf dag één. Je start met een gedegen 30-60-90-dagen-onboardingprogramma met duidelijke milestones, zodat je precies weet waar je staat en waar je naartoe werkt. Je wordt daarnaast getraind en gecertificeerd via Winning by Design, hét toonaangevende salestrainingsprogramma voor SaaS, inclusief SPICED-certificering. Daarbovenop krijg je een persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 per jaar om te investeren in wat jou verder brengt: cursussen, conferenties, boeken of coaching. Jij kiest. Verder bieden we een brutojaarsalaris van €55.000 tot €75.000 inclusief vakantiegeld op basis van 40 uur per week, afhankelijk van je ervaring. description: About Us Ada is an AI customer service company whose mission is to make customer service extraordinary for everyone. We're driven to raise a new standard of quality customer service at scale, enabling enterprise companies to deliver experiences that people love–instant, proactive, personalized, and effortless. Ada is an AI transformation platform and partner—combining strategic expertise with powerful AI agent management technology to accelerate businesses’ AI maturity to keep them ahead of the curve. With Ada, 83% of customer conversations—and counting—are effortlessly resolved through automation, giving teams more time back, companies more resources to focus on growth, and customers more life to focus on what matters most to them. Established in 2016, Ada is a Canadian company that has powered over 5.5 billion interactions for leading brands like Square, YETI, IPSY, and Monday.com , saving millions of hours of human effort. Backed with over $250M in funding from tier-one investors including Accel, Bessemer, FirstMark, Spark, and Version One Ventures, Ada is a pioneer in the management and application of AI in customer service. If you’re ambitious and eager to grow, Ada could be the place for you. Learn more at www.ada.cx . We’re looking for a Senior Solution Architect to be the trusted technical advisor to our clients and deal teams, from pre-sales to long after launch. Serve as the technical advisor to Customer Success on existing and strategic accounts, identifying where technical solutions can improve a client’s AI Agent performance. Technically curious and resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment. Experience with Zendesk, Salesforce, Amazon Connect, Microsoft Dynamics, or Oracle is a plus. Give Customer Success the technical options that help existing clients raise their automated resolution rate. Take bespoke solutions from scope to production with our engineers, with specs they can build against. title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
description: Senior AI/ML Engineer, remote in Canada: own the AI that assesses patients for US healthcare providers and gets them to the right mental health care faster. About Limbic Limbic’s vision is to ensure the highest quality therapy is accessible to everyone, everywhere. Limbic has supported more than 820,000 patients across the UK and the US. We are used in over 50% of NHS Talking Therapies services, which makes us the largest-ever deployment of generative AI for direct patient care, and our AI now delivers end-to-end therapy to patients in the US under the supervision of licensed clinicians. Safety and science come first. We are the only AI mental health chatbot with UKCA Class IIa medical device certification, and the first AI-led mental healthcare company selected for the FDA’s TEMPO pilot. Our results are published in leading scientific journals: in a randomized, double-blind trial published in Nature Medicine, our AI agents scored higher than licensed CBT therapists on a standard measure of therapy skill. The Role As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will take ownership of the AI in our clinical assessment product for US healthcare organizations. A patient describes what they are struggling with in a conversation with our AI, which gathers their history, administers standard clinical questionnaires such as PHQ-9 and GAD-7, detects risk and recommends a treatment program for the organization’s clinicians to review. Every organization configures it for its own services, so the AI has to be safe and accurate across many clinical setups, not just one. The approach is proven at scale in the NHS, where it increased referrals from minority groups by 29%, as published in Nature Medicine. You will work in North American hours alongside product, engineering and clinical colleagues, in close collaboration with our ML team in London. Our AI products are built on shared platforms for agents, evaluation and safety, so the systems you design are reused across Limbic. What You’ll Do Own the quality of the conversational AI that runs patient assessments, from each step of the conversation to clinical prediction and treatment recommendation. Improve the safety checks that screen every patient message and AI reply, covering risk, attempts to manipulate the AI, unsafe medical advice and clinically inappropriate responses, so they catch more problems without flagging good replies. Productionize ML models that optimize product KPIs, including the accuracy of clinical predictions and how quickly patients reach the right care. Build and maintain evaluation harnesses, simulated patient conversations and labelled transcript review, so every configuration can be tested before a patient sees it. Extend our assessment AI to new channels, including the phone, so that patients who cannot or will not use a web form still have a way in. Help turn our clinical AI into composable services that healthcare partners can integrate into their own patient journeys. Build agents and tooling that automate product development workflows, including reliable testing and customer demos. Raise the engineering bar through architecture, code review and mentorship, while keeping our AI continuously compliant with strict regulatory requirements. What You’ll Bring You must meet one of the following educational and experience backgrounds: A PhD in computational science or an AI-related field, plus 2 years of experience in an ML engineering role. OR A BSc/MSc, plus 4 years of experience in an ML engineering role. Expertise in productizing LLM features and a strong background in eval-driven development. Expert-level proficiency in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript. Proven experience building an LLM agent harness . Experience utilizing reinforcement learning. Strong architectural skills with experience designing scalable, production-grade systems for machine learning applications. A solid understanding of statistical principles in the context of LLM evaluation and user activity analytics. Proficiency with version control systems (preferably Git) and databases (SQL or NoSQL). Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform and containerization technologies. A track record of end-to-end ownership: you scope work you can ship quickly, measure its impact, and keep a sense of urgency when the stakes are high. A genuine interest in applying your technical skills to solve complex challenges in the mental healthcare space. Ideal but not required: Experience with real-time voice AI, or with healthcare organizations as customers. North American business hours (Eastern time preferred), with daily overlap with colleagues in Europe (UTC to UTC+3). Based in Canada with the right to work there. raw.jobDescription:
Senior AI/ML Engineer, remote in Canada: own the AI that assesses patients for US healthcare providers and gets them to the right mental health care faster.

About Limbic

Limbic’s vision is to ensure the highest quality therapy is accessible to everyone, everywhere.

Limbic has supported more than 820,000 patients across the UK and the US. We are used in over 50% of NHS Talking Therapies services, which makes us the largest-ever deployment of generative AI for direct patient care, and our AI now delivers end-to-end therapy to patients in the US under the supervision of licensed clinicians.

Safety and science come first. We are the only AI mental health chatbot with UKCA Class IIa medical device certification, and the first AI-led mental healthcare company selected for the FDA’s TEMPO pilot. Our results are published in leading scientific journals: in a randomized, double-blind trial published in Nature Medicine, our AI agents scored higher than licensed CBT therapists on a standard measure of therapy skill.

The Role

As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will take ownership of the AI in our clinical assessment product for US healthcare organizations. A patient describes what they are struggling with in a conversation with our AI, which gathers their history, administers standard clinical questionnaires such as PHQ-9 and GAD-7, detects risk and recommends a treatment program for the organization’s clinicians to review. Every organization configures it for its own services, so the AI has to be safe and accurate across many clinical setups, not just one.

The approach is proven at scale in the NHS, where it increased referrals from minority groups by 29%, as published in Nature Medicine. You will work in North American hours alongside product, engineering and clinical colleagues, in close collaboration with our ML team in London. Our AI products are built on shared platforms for agents, evaluation and safety, so the systems you design are reused across Limbic.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the quality of the conversational AI that runs patient assessments, from each step of the conversation to clinical prediction and treatment recommendation.

  • Improve the safety checks that screen every patient message and AI reply, covering risk, attempts to manipulate the AI, unsafe medical advice and clinically inappropriate responses, so they catch more problems without flagging good replies.

  • Productionize ML models that optimize product KPIs, including the accuracy of clinical predictions and how quickly patients reach the right care.

  • Build and maintain evaluation harnesses, simulated patient conversations and labelled transcript review, so every configuration can be tested before a patient sees it.

  • Extend our assessment AI to new channels, including the phone, so that patients who cannot or will not use a web form still have a way in.

  • Help turn our clinical AI into composable services that healthcare partners can integrate into their own patient journeys.

  • Build agents and tooling that automate product development workflows, including reliable testing and customer demos.

  • Raise the engineering bar through architecture, code review and mentorship, while keeping our AI continuously compliant with strict regulatory requirements.

What You’ll Bring

  • You must meet one of the following educational and experience backgrounds:

    • A PhD in computational science or an AI-related field, plus 2 years of experience in an ML engineering role.

    • OR A BSc/MSc, plus 4 years of experience in an ML engineering role.

  • Expertise in productizing LLM features and a strong background in eval-driven development.

  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript.

  • Proven experience building an LLM agent harness.

  • Experience utilizing reinforcement learning.

  • Strong architectural skills with experience designing scalable, production-grade systems for machine learning applications.

  • A solid understanding of statistical principles in the context of LLM evaluation and user activity analytics.

  • Proficiency with version control systems (preferably Git) and databases (SQL or NoSQL).

  • Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform and containerization technologies.

  • A track record of end-to-end ownership: you scope work you can ship quickly, measure its impact, and keep a sense of urgency when the stakes are high.

  • A genuine interest in applying your technical skills to solve complex challenges in the mental healthcare space.

  • Ideal but not required: Experience with real-time voice AI, or with healthcare organizations as customers.

  • North American business hours (Eastern time preferred), with daily overlap with colleagues in Europe (UTC to UTC+3).

  • Based in Canada with the right to work there.

    • Please note: Limbic cannot provide visa sponsorship in Canada.

Benefits & Wellbeing

  • Salary: CA$173,000 – CA$192,000 per year.

  • Equity share options.

  • 25 days PTO.

  • Support with purchasing work-related books and materials.

  • Quarterly Life Days: Enjoy 4 paid days off per year (one each quarter) to use whenever you choose to relax, recharge, or take care of personal matters.

  • Mental Health Support: Access to dedicated mental health support services.

We encourage women and individuals from diverse backgrounds to apply and join our team. We believe in creating an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can contribute their best.

Mattermost takes a market-based approach to pay. Actual compensation may vary based on location, skills, experience, qualifications, and market conditions.

raw.jobDescription:
Backend Engineer

About LaunchDarkly Engineering

LaunchDarkly helps engineering organizations ship software and AI with speed, safety, and control. Our platform gives teams the confidence to release gradually, target experiences to the right audiences, learn through experimentation, understand what is happening in production, and respond quickly when risk appears.

Our engineers build the systems, services, SDKs, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, and product experiences that make this possible. The work spans high-scale distributed systems, reliable data and event pipelines, intuitive enterprise workflows, and AI-powered capabilities that help teams manage the next generation of software delivery.

LaunchDarkly’s SDKs are used in systems that perform trillions of feature flag evaluations each day, giving our engineering work a direct connection to the reliability and customer experience of software around the world. As the company grows, we are expanding beyond traditional feature management into experimentation, observability, and AgentControl—helping customers control more of the software and AI lifecycle. That creates an unusually broad set of technical challenges, visible customer impact, and room for engineers to shape what comes next.

We believe in the power of teams. We work with humility, openness, curiosity, and care; we value clear communication, thoughtful technical judgment, inclusive collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership. We encourage people to apply even when they do not meet every qualification listed below. We are interested in the experience, perspective, and potential you would bring to the role.

About the role

We have multiple backend engineering roles open on various teams. The specific level, scope, and technical focus will be aligned to the opportunity and the candidate’s experience. Experience with cloud platforms, distributed systems, developer tools, SDK engineering, data infrastructure, observability, or AI/agent systems may be relevant for some teams.

As a Backend Engineer at LaunchDarkly, you will design, build, and operate the services that power reliable software delivery for our customers. You may work on APIs, distributed systems, configuration and event pipelines, data services, SDK-related infrastructure, platform capabilities, or backend systems supporting our product experiences.

You will work with experienced engineers, Product, Design, and partner teams to turn customer and business needs into simple, scalable solutions. You will have the opportunity to own work from early design through production, learn from real customer impact, and contribute to systems that operate at meaningful scale.

What you’ll do

  • Design, implement, test, and operate production services and APIs.
  • Lead projects or meaningful components of projects from problem definition through deployment and iteration.
  • Make thoughtful tradeoffs across scalability, performance, reliability, security, maintainability, and delivery speed.
  • Improve the observability and operability of the systems you own, including metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and incident learnings.
  • Collaborate with Product, Design, Support, Customer Success, and other engineering teams to understand needs and deliver useful outcomes.
  • Participate in technical design discussions and code reviews, sharing constructive feedback and learning from teammates.
  • Investigate production issues calmly and help turn operational lessons into lasting improvements.
  • Contribute to a culture of inclusive collaboration, continuous improvement, and high-quality engineering.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building and operating production software in a professional environment, or equivalent demonstrable experience.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, testing, debugging, and API design.
  • Experience with a backend language such as Go, Python, Rust, or an equivalent language. (Most of our teams use Go)
  • Experience designing or contributing to services that need to be reliable, observable, and maintainable as usage grows.
  • Ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical partners.
  • A collaborative approach and a sense of ownership for both your work and its downstream customer impact.
  • Comfort learning unfamiliar systems and working through ambiguous problems.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 3:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $171,200 - $235,400**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $154,100 - $211,860 **
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $145,500 - $200,090 **

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

raw.jobDescription:
About Us

Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just check out their tweets to see for yourself!)

Founded by Feross Aboukhadijeh, a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised $125M in funding from top angels, operators, and security leaders.

About the Role

  • Build product: This role will require you to move fast, prioritize ruthlessly, and be focused on the end user. Your voice will be essential in shaping the product and the roadmap, and your decisions will have immediate and far-reaching impact. You will work in collaboration with the engineering and design teams.

  • Grow the team and culture: As an early member of the team, you will form the defining DNA for the company's culture and our future team. Our ability to build a market-defining product is solely dependent on the culture we foster.

  • Set up foundational frameworks: You'll join at the genesis of something totally new and come into a fast-paced environment. We value process-driven systems that enable us to work smarter as we scale, and you'll build out design systems that will serve as guide rails for the engineering team.

What You'll Do

  • Contribute to the development of the Socket web application end-to-end

  • Work with the design team to develop interfaces that abstract away complexities and delivers an elegant and delightful user experience

  • Write APIs to deliver data from multiple data sources

  • Extract and transform data from 3rd party APIs

  • Help shape the roadmap and plan sprints that allow us to quickly deliver features and be agile to user feedback

  • Be a key part of hiring, including interviewing and providing input into team growth decisions

What You'll Bring

  • You've worked on an early stage team in a 0-1 role and would like to get back to building the foundations again

  • Experience with designing and implementing production web applications

  • Experience with building and integrating APIs and relational databases like Postgres

  • Proficiency with Node.js, JavaScript, React, and TypeScript

  • Not bound to a particular tech stack and can learn new technologies on-the-go

  • Bonus points for experience with any of the following technologies GraphQL, ElasticSearch, Headless browsers, data pipelines

Our Interview Process

  1. Informational with a member from our Talent Team

  2. Hiring Manager Interview

  3. Technical Interviews

  4. Debrief

  5. Final Interview with Feross

  6. References

  7. Decision/Offer

Leveling and compensation will be aligned dynamically throughout the interview process to match your technical scope and background.

Hiring is a big decision on both sides. Read more about our Hiring Philosophy and how we approach the process at Socket.

Benefits: Our benefits are crafted to support you and your family, so you can take care of what matters most and thrive in and outside of work. We offer:

  • Market competitive salary bands

  • Meaningful equity program

  • Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage)

  • Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge

  • Paid parental leave

  • Remote-first, with quarterly team off-sites

At Socket, we

  1. Pursue Excellence: We set ourselves apart by consistently delivering work of exceptional quality and distinction.

  2. Move with urgency and focus: We prioritize swift, decisive action.

  3. Think rigorously: We care about being right and it often takes reasoning from first principles to get there. We value alternative perspectives and have constructive discussions.

  4. Trust and amplify: We overtrust, always assume good intent, and give specific feedback to help each other improve.

  5. Feel a strong sense of ownership: We wear many hats and feel a strong sense of overall ownership of the company and we're non-territorial regarding our nominal domains.

  6. Are customer obsessed: We relentlessly prioritize the needs of our customers, striving to exceed their expectations and delight them at every interaction.
